candidate_passages.text: For new campaign authoring, a **location** is the whole persistent setting, a **hotspot** is an interactive point within it, and a **chapter** is a story beat. Use `experiments/tangible-campaign/schema/campaign.ts`, `engine/campaign.ts`, `ui/current-scenarios.ts`, `ui/current-campaign.ts` and `ui/stories/`. Old scenario/model/scenarios files are explicit v1 compatibility contracts. Read `docs/location-hotspot-terminology.md` before changing saves. Run `npm run campaign:check`, `npm run campaign:test` and `npm run campaign:build` for this shared campaign. The root app and its original scripts remain separate. The combined persistent-location/artwork implementation is documented in `docs/persistent-locations-and-artwork.md`. Start it at `campaign-start.html`; never replace the unrelated root index to mirror the isolated Site homepage. The historical instructions below retain their original checkpoint wording.
Please keep working notes in notes.md -- these are to keep track of what your ideas are, what hypothesis you're testing, what your goal is, what your strategy is.

My overriding hypothesis: if the AI can build a harness where it has subagents play the game, and it can evaluate those games for how much "fun" they are, then it can continue iterating until it really does produce something that's fun. Therefore the single most important part of this project is (1) research widely in the literature what game designers think constitutes "fun", (2) embody that in a closed-loop grader.

- My caveat: if the tradeoff is "can I spend these resources" then that's a bit lame and turns you into a greengrocer. In many games the tradeoff is "do I have time to do this action" either in a realtime game against the clock, or in a turn-based game against the oponent. But there must be more interesting tradeoffs
Every idea must be DISCARDED if it doesn't further these three givens. We must explore and experiment, and not be afraid to try and throw away different paths.

- Normal playspace objects are things (rounded rectangles) and locations (hollow, square-cornered rectangles). Named slotted constructions are an explicit extension: slots belong inside the thing, not to an accumulating location. Results must be recognizable things, not generic bags of components.

- Locations have three roles: a meaningful setting for a binary combination; one operand producing a portable thing; or a place where a functional thing satisfies an objective. Placement is freely reversible. A location must not silently collect and combine several things.

- Finger dragging a thing should move it, while dragging empty space scrolls the playspace. Drag highlights must persist and distinguish a valid creation drop. Reset must fully replay instructions and be reachable from an open instruction dialog. The user resets these checkpoints, so migration work is not a priority.

Current focus: Mars, Atlas of Questions, Elements, From Hearth to Snack Cake, Why This Boat, and Doctrine: Grace and Matter. Preserve other sketches and archived direct routes. Every non-opening chapter should meaningfully use earlier-created work; merely carrying an unused token or raw supply does not count. Research candidates and the manuscript reader remain IN PROGRESS / NOT LIVE at the 6204 source checkpoint. Preserve negative findings, raw play evidence and exact source provenance; never equate mechanical completion or simulated play with proof of human fun.

6327d73216d54ea8562d7d75eca3e0a34ce245e1.disposition: reconciled: current principles extracted; superseded mechanics remain historical

candidate_passages.text: - A location must make sense as a whole: actual background, indoor/outdoor setting, hotspots, new supplies and carried objects. A text label must not explain away an exterior ice deposit or mast pictured inside a room. Check physical access, scale and story purpose together.

- Fixed structures stay at their actual place. A change of worktable must not pack a whole greenhouse, refuge or kiln as if it were a portable supply. If a later task concerns a fixed structure, author a truthful way to work there or use an actual portable subsystem; do not solve it by renaming the same building.

- Richer backgrounds are welcome. Partner highlights must remain unmistakable over them, using strong contrasting shape/outline rather than a subtle color change alone. Apply this equally to tiles and hotspots.

- A map or survey must answer a story question and help someone act. Expeditions can begin with plausible existing regional/orbital maps. Local observations should resolve a meaningful uncertainty (such as access, terrain or resources), not manufacture successive generic map categories. Research what the equipment can establish and keep the result's limits honest.

- A new chapter in the **same location** keeps every surviving item and the player's layout. The chapter boundary must never automatically carry/import earlier-location items, prune items, rearrange the work surface or re-grant existing stock. It does not start a fresh board or pretend to travel.

- **Artwork is now authorized:** use vivid, clearly visible persistent background art for each setting, shared across its chapters; preserve contrast with local backing behind labels and controls. Decorative scenery must not imply inventory or completed work that is not present. Movable objects, labels and tasks remain independently legible.

- **Fixed phone-like panels:** a location has a bounded 390 × 844 logical reference area, responsive down to narrow phones and compact on desktop. It never grows to fit more objects. Previously visited panels stay visible above it, with vertical scrollback and deliberate dragging between discovered locations. Storage ownership is separate from the story's active location; moving an object backward does not restart travel, grant stock or change its provenance.

- Created objects may overlap reasonably; each must remain reachable for dragging or double-tap explanation. Normal authored play should not demand housekeeping. Arrival-stock packing must not create new overlaps by squeezing a carried arrangement; removing genuine empty gaps and moving rigid clusters on first arrival is different from rearranging residents. Source cards retain their full readable size.

- A genuine commercial kitchen station (pastry bench, hot line, confectionery counter) may be a distinct location. An explicit later shift can also have a new panel in the same physical setting: explain the time change and cleared workspace, retain the earlier panel, and bring actual prepared food forward. Never use an arbitrary chapter reset as a disguised cleanup.

- Normal partner highlighting is a core affordance: show it transiently on press and throughout a thing-drag, including hotspot operands and relevant current-goal things. Hotspot frames are fixed targets, not draggable things. Show legal existing partners and valid drops, not future output-name previews. Highlights must not disappear merely because a source is gold or a target is a hotspot; they must not promise an illegal direction or an already-existing result.

- Never create another C when that output already exists, including in an earlier location or fitted construction. Moving, fitting or incorporating an output is not permission to reconstruct a duplicate. Alternative routes should converge on existing output identities where appropriate; distinct real objects in different kitchens can still share a familiar label.

- After a successful creation, surviving dragged A returns to its original position; B stays put. New C appears close to the receiving B, or **inside the hotspot target** when the hotspot is the operand, and remains portable rather than permanently attached. The explicit transformation and installation rules below take precedence over this ordinary birth rule. A same-token drop is a no-op/rejection, never deletion.

Clear, simple object names are a mandatory baseline, not an optional polish pass. Assume the player may skip chapter prose, cache narrative and double-tap explanations. The task list, object/hotspot names, text printed on tiles, visible fitted components and normal interaction feedback must make the action intelligible. A short quotation already printed on a tile counts; a crucial premise hidden behind an explanation does not.

- A key quotation can be the item itself: 5–12 words need not collapse into an icon. All long labels—including observations and cases—need matching line space in rendering and packing. Explanations must explain the object or idea in ordinary language, not expose authoring instructions, recipes, research citations or dense source notes. Preserve genuine quotations faithfully and explain their meaning plainly.
- Celebrate an actually achieved invention. An unfinished Rover shell is not a working Rover; required fitted parts and the authored capability must be present before celebrating it.

- Keep mundane procedural combinations uncelebrated and never replay an old-save backlog as newly earned. A dismissed celebration happens once per run. Pending rewards and acknowledgement survive saving; Undo removes unearned pending events but does not repeat a dismissed triumph. Reset starts a fresh run; debug checkpoints identify their replayed achievements as historical.

- An educational wonder must make sense before the reader sees its item name. Write a self-contained explanation of the idea, discovery or useful distinction in ordinary English, including the subject and the necessary context. Do not rely on a heading to supply the missing premise, offer only a teasing slogan, or make the player decode the prose.

- Each recipe explicitly declares every object input as `transform`, `incorporate`, or `retain`, with a reason. An upgrade or physical incorporation consumes its original at the event when no independent use needs an outside copy; reusable tools and supplies remain when another use still needs them. This is not a finite-stock simulation or a blanket everything-stays rule. Exhausting an input's future uses is a warning to review its lifecycle, never permission to delete it automatically.

- Adding to a fitted rover should keep the same recognisable rover and its fitted parts. Prefer installation in its existing slots. Never collapse a compound into an apparently simple object. When joining assemblies or genuinely changing an assembly's identity, explicitly preserve and display its existing components through subsequent transformations. A change of name is not a disassembly.

- In Markdown authoring, give a goal a useful purpose and accept plausible alternative results: "Cook a cauliflower dish" can accept either gratin or buttered cauliflower. Alternatives should give the player more ways to discover a satisfactory answer. Require both outputs only when both have a purpose, such as plain pastry for a later preparation and cheese straws for the current meal. Optional dead-end products must earn the attention they ask for; do not make every existing recipe required merely to preserve it.

- An enhanced thing satisfies the function it genuinely retains: an upgraded radio or growing shelter must not fail merely because its name changed. Preserve real functional distinctions; a radio's little supply is not automatically a rover's traction power. No exact-name barrier should manufacture extra work.

- Every non-opening chapter must meaningfully use at least one, preferably several, objects or ideas created in an earlier chapter. An item merely remaining in inventory, or an old raw supply, does not satisfy this.

- Distinguish actual new supplies spatially: existing objects above a dotted “new items” line, actual deliveries below. Do not use New/Carried labels or divide the screen into arbitrary halves. Compact genuine empty vertical gaps only when needed, without introducing new overlaps; fixed locations remain bounded. The first intentional committed crossing or successful cross-group combination removes the line; cancellation, rejection, reading, resizing and reload do not. Undo restores the earlier split. The lower group contains only this arrival's actual fresh grants, never old-location spillover or existing things reclassified as new. Crossing is scoped to those groups in that location. With no fresh delivery, do not add a divider or rearrange settled objects; old saves are not retroactively relaid out.

- A kitchen or cooking station should support several services, with ordinary ingredients and tools introduced when its stores become available, not a fresh box of bespoke materials for each chapter. Keep the active work surface manageable; a substantial facility may have small, clearly established workrooms. New chapters on the same work surface must not repack or relocate settled objects.

- Entering a skipped chapter still introduces its genuine caches and hotspots. Supplies remain tangible with their original provenance and new-versus-old classification through a cascade; never fabricate combinations or invention rewards. Empty source locations do not retain a delivery divider.

- Every recipe should earn its place through a meaningful, recognisable result or use, not graph padding. Every non-opening chapter must meet the earlier-created-item continuity rule above; merely carrying an item is not meaningful reuse. Historical influence, analogy and physical lifecycle are different claims and need different evidence.

- Grade **factual/authenticity accuracy** and **forward player intuition/useful purpose** separately. A historically or physically defensible account can still fail the player-facing test; an authenticity reviewer must not approve a contrived recipe merely because it can be explained afterwards.

Historical contracts remain intact. In particular, old automatic-hiding rules, permanent past-stage gold, compulsory equipment-delivery chores, chapter-equals-travel assumptions, selected-tile/Read-button interaction, top-right objectives, automatic chapter handoff, uniformly rare wonders, and the proposed alternating Mars narrators are superseded where they conflict with this document. Frozen source manifests and test evidence describe their pinned revisions; update current behaviour through an explicit successor, never rewrite an old audit to claim it already proved the new direction.

Keep objectives fully visible at normal opacity throughout pointer down, movement, cancellation and drop. Dragging must not hide, dim or grey out the objective text. A tile may cover only the text it actually overlaps, because tiles sit above the objectives; the rest remains readable.

candidate_passages.text: This is a designer proposal for the owner's requested180–240 decision opportunities, not an implemented or validated long game. Bell2 is a separate frozen short experience. Its central question may improve a hook, but adding another hundred paired-name revelations would be padding.

Build one valley or archipelago whose rivers, settlements, living forms and institutions persist. A created relationship **carries something**: water, seeds, voices, authority or promises. Its recipients can transform what arrives and carry consequences onward. The same connection that makes coordination possible can spread a disturbance or erase an independent voice. The world never resets to another independent target vector.

Breadth alone does not make180 decisions. The model must support cycles of intention, commitment, world response and renewed intention. A long playtest should record those episodes and the player's reasons for continuing, including moments when a solved construction is worth enacting and moments when it becomes overhead. Do not count every combine or every confirmation as a meaningful decision.

For the real long test, record progress at approximately30,60,120 and180 commitments, while preserving that commitments are not automatically decision episodes. Ask what unresolved intention the player is pursuing, which prior creation now matters differently, and whether they would choose to continue. A player choosing to stop is evidence about absorption, not a failed participant. An evaluator must not transform a forced180-command completion into proof of a30-minute game.

candidate_passages.text: This screen follows the owner's explicit design requirement: every legal combination and result may be inspected; the challenge must survive that information. The player must also perform the join rather than select a finished product from a menu. [Design contract](design-contract.md).

**Selection: prototype geometry-sensitive joining first.** It places the consequential decision inside the physical gesture. The cheap models support that selection mechanically; they do not establish that a polyomino puzzle is enjoyable, novel, or a good long-term direction. The strongest concern is that it may become a familiar jigsaw whose only satisfying moment is spotting one fit. Actual browser play must decide whether the combining operation adds something worthwhile.

**Skill hypothesis.** Plan a small portfolio of constructions, noticing which scarce input has another important use. An optional inefficient opening can leave a longer but possible route rather than a concealed instant loss.

**Skill hypothesis.** Coordinate transformations and recognize a useful intermediate. The same grain/water/heat/culture should favor different orders under an announced early-meal requirement or fading warmth.

**Skill hypothesis.** Mental rotation and global spatial planning, supported by tangible local experiments. A useful insight can be unique; several cosmetically reordered solutions are not required for the puzzle to be worthwhile. The relevant question is whether seeing and making the join is appealing, understandable, and transferable to a fresh outline.

**Small test and kill criterion.** Three or four pieces, a single visible silhouette and generous Undo. Every edge-adjacent non-overlapping join is legal and fully previewed. Reject if the outline makes every placement obvious, if pointer precision dominates spatial reasoning, or if an exact-fit puzzle makes the combining gesture feel redundant. A failed join must be readable and reversible. Do not introduce timers or a secondary system to rescue an uninteresting fit.

Every piece is a set of integer cells. Rotations are allowed, reflection is not. A legal fusion joins two rigid components edge-to-edge without overlap. Components and outcomes are canonicalized up to rotation; equivalent component labels and interleavings are not counted as separate opening choices. The diagnostic model bounds shapes to5×5 for finite enumeration. A target must contain exactly all supplied cells.

This is useful failure evidence because the rejected move is legal and locally plausible under full information. It must not be presented as a surprise hidden exception. A production interface can preview the actual shape while leaving the global packing inference to the player.

All cases have found winning paths, requiring2–6 fusions. Each has2–6 distinct terminal capability/unused-resource signatures among shortest solutions. The broader count of all terminal signatures ranges from3 to95, but includes inefficient preparations and must not be advertised as depth. Recipe-order permutations collapse to the same inventory state. The signature compares actual held capabilities and unused raw materials, not action names.

candidate_passages.text: **Subsequent user correction:** finite physical materials and stock management are rejected. The allocation proposal and finite-pool comparisons below are retained as historical research, not current recommendations. All known materials remain permanently available; no resource, copy, budget or hidden-cost substitute may restore the rejected scarcity. The next geometry screen must use unlimited copies. An awkward compound can be set aside, so it is never a globally lost session: only that compound's ability to extend into the target can be blocked. If unlimited copies remove the worthwhile spatial choice, discard this candidate instead of restoring scarcity.

The question is whether an informed player has something worthwhile to work out or perform. Hover information has earned protection through actual owner feedback. An AI player's preference for less information is not a vote that cancels that evidence. The slight confusion about which icon displays an outcome can be addressed while preserving the information.

| Greg Costikyan, [I Have No Words & I Must Design](https://worrydream.com/refs/Costikyan_2002_-_I_Have_No_Words_and_I_Must_Design.pdf), 2002 revision; printed pp.14–17, “Struggle.” Original proceedings text read through a mirror. | Costikyan distinguishes a nominal goal from an obstacle and argues that greater mastery should improve a solitaire player's chances. **Inference:** compare informed and uninformed performance, then identify what the information enabled. A win-rate gap can show a usable obstacle without showing pleasure. PDF text supplied these passages; no visual-layout claim is made. |

Koster's information-progress account also differs from the owner's preference for knowing local combinations. The intended remaining uncertainty concerns a plan's usefulness or the player's performance. We should not restore uncertainty about the authors' vocabulary to satisfy a generic curiosity metric.

**Small playable question:** given a handful of physical pieces, how should their shared ingredients be committed to useful results? Put the remaining copies on the shelf itself. At least one intermediate must be usable in two consequential ways. The screen needs one visible problem and its consequences, not a request list plus an inventory dashboard.

Normalize solutions before crediting diversity. Swapping independent joins, using a different copy of an identical ingredient, or producing the same final capability through renamed equivalent objects does not create another mechanism. Distinct resource allocations can be real alternatives, but the report must say what one sacrifices for the other. Changing numerical reward weights can create a preference reversal by construction; include a contextual change that affects causal usefulness, so the screen does not only demonstrate reading the larger number.

**Small playable question:** which two pieces should touch, and how should their join be arranged so the resulting object does something useful? Begin with a few chunky pieces, forgiving snapping and one visible gap or load. Joining, bracing and reusing the joined object remain the verbs. Geometry must change the composition's behavior, not just its appearance.

**Tangible-performance check:** snapping two actual endpoints must form a manipulable joint and result. Choosing “triangular brace” from an output card while the program assembles it repeats the rejected delegation problem. Rotating or positioning an actual joined construction can belong to combining when that geometry causes its behavior.
| Check | Evidence to retain | Counterexample the grader must recognize |

A source-informed screen should name one worthwhile decision and its strongest trivial explanation. A browser player must then face the ordinary visible interface without a privileged rules packet. Mechanical screening can reject a forced script or false affordance cheaply; it cannot validate the desired visceral feeling. The owner's positive response establishes a discoverability preference, while enjoyment of the next challenge remains unknown until someone actually encounters it.

candidate_passages.text: Research checked 25 October 2026, following the user's request to make physically combining the primary interaction and to reconsider every other design commitment. This is a comparison of nine games. It includes fully expanded representative chains, links to larger catalogues, acquisition and process prerequisites, and explicit coverage limits. It is **not** a verified export of every recipe in all nine games.

The distinction that matters most for the next prototype is between **choosing a product** and **performing a combination**. Two interfaces can implement the same dependency graph and produce a different experience of agency. A catalogue can tell us what is legal; it cannot tell us whether moving, joining, grinding or arranging the ingredients feels good. The new workbench must test the latter directly.

The chain is one route, not the whole graph. The same official pages show alternatives: Glass can also use Heat, Electricity or Lightning with Sand. These are separate branches with their own prerequisites, not free synonyms. The [official catalogue](https://hints.littlealchemy2.com/) is the larger lookup source, with [official help](https://help.littlealchemy2.com/hints/using-hints) describing hints based on things already discovered. Base browser content and the mobile Myths and Monsters pack must not be counted together without an edition label.

**Relevant skill and limit.** Finding a promising relation, remembering an intermediate and deciding what to try can support curiosity. A large list also allows an authored answer to become the obstacle. For this project, show a legal partner and its potential result at contact so the player can predict the local outcome while still doing the joining. Test whether contact-time disclosure preserves curiosity better than selecting an output from a menu. This is our design hypothesis, not a finding about the original game's players.

**Fuller-chain source and scope.** [Recipes by station](https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Crafting_stations) and [Work Bench recipes](https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Recipes/Work_Bench) organize a much larger graph. Modern Desktop/Console/Mobile documentation includes 1.4.5 changes; legacy console/3DS and mods must be separated. The current documentation notes changed station interaction/range and nearby-chest behavior, so old control instructions are unsafe to import.

**Relevant skill and limit.** The player handles the thing that changes meaning, rather than issuing an abstract research command. A university/ideas game could use inspectable arguments, mechanisms or inference rules in this way. Historical schools must not be assigned arbitrary “wins Nobel Prizes” recipe outputs and called a causal model. Test whether a consistent small grammar transfers to a new situation before adding historical nouns.

For a future machine-readable catalogue, an ingredient list is insufficient. Our proposed representation is a directed hypergraph with input multiplicities, outputs, catalysts/stations, operation, unlock guard, acquisition edge and edition/source attached. It must allow cycles and alternate routes: reversible packing, repeated production and rule rearrangement do not form a single clean dependency tree. A displayed chain is one rooted projection of that larger model. This schema is a research proposal; no complete multi-game export has been built in this pass.

headings: Three challenge concepts and the first selection

2. A town above the spillway — selected direction

candidate_passages.text: **Situation.** A traveller is approaching a sanctuary along three connected paths. Ringing the sanctuary bell ends the encounter; the player must buy enough time to prepare it. The traveller has a readable motive: avoid dangerous terrain, take the shortest safe route, then break an obstruction when no shorter safe route exists. Show the next action and the rule that selected it. A rule learned in encounter one must remain true in encounter three.

**A concrete decision.** The traveller will cross the centre approach next turn. Mud is available now. Deploying it at the centre forces a one-turn detour to the left; this buys discovery time but changes the future approach. Alternatively, develop a brick barrier while the traveller advances. That barrier blocks for longer, but the player must spend the next deployment on the traveller's new lane. In the larger proposal, a sanctuary seal offers a finite endpoint; barriers should create opportunities to finish it rather than become an endless stun cycle.

**Skill.** Planning flows across space and time. The player must distinguish a temporary buffer from a durable solution, reason about what happens to diverted water, and decide when invention is worth allowing a pulse to advance. Several routes should succeed: temporary storage buys time for growth, a diversion sends water safely through a prepared lower route, or a longer recipe path builds a reliable drain.

**A concrete decision.** Four water units will reach the upper orchard. A levee can turn the flow south immediately, saving the orchard but sending it toward the lower workshop. A basin can hold part of the pulse while leaving the lower route clear. Alternatively, discovering reeds now might establish ongoing absorption, but the orchard must tolerate the current pulse before the new concept can be deployed. After the levee decision, the next choice changes: make the lower route safe or reverse the diversion. This is a specific plan consequence, not merely a different damage amount.

**Selection.** Continue this direction because it lets us inspect spatial consequences with fewer interpretation rules. This is a reasoned choice of experimental tractability, not evidence that floods are more enjoyable than opponents. The tiny screen exposes shallow strategies in both candidates; the playable routing model must answer those failures rather than merely grow the menu.

**Situation.** Play the defending commander as a heroic ship advances from your fortified home toward its own border. The campaign is an advancing front, not literal reverse time. Early encounters give the commander heavy ships and strong installations. Later encounters reduce material advantage while the player's knowledge of formations, timing, and enemy movement grows. The hero retains a visible, consistent movement policy within an encounter; changes in upgrades must be announced rather than used as hidden difficulty balancing.

**Rejection gate and decision.** Park it for this elemental slice. It introduces hero navigation, collision or targeting rules, formation timing, and campaign inversion before showing why element combinations help. Those mechanics could independently carry a game; that would leave the combination hypothesis unresolved. Retain the campaign idea for a separate prototype if the routing slice fails or an elemental formation mechanic earns its place.

**Access condition.** These are mechanical policy screens, not blind subagent playtests. Every policy knows the rules. The depth-four, beam-18 planner can call the transition model and consequently sees the deterministic future schedule. The goal policy is a hand-authored strategy using knowledge of the recipe graph. These results must never be pooled with fair AI-player results or human findings.

| **Ada, at Lantern Reach** | The collective speaker’s work | “An invitation only your members can hear is not an invitation to us.” Ada wants genuine public access for people the shared project did not initially represent. | A beacon extends the work’s reach. Publishing the living answer and exposing its inherited exact addresses must remain distinguishable; earlier quotation and custody choices matter again. |

| **The shared call** | Make a work that can address an absent community and receive an answer | Couple two continuing processes; a return relation must work in both directions, and public fragments cannot substitute for an exact address | The old paths become parts of a reciprocal circuit; an exact record may be useful while remaining dangerous to publish |

2. **Give recipients a policy and a project.** A recipient responds to relevant changes in its received work, jurisdiction or accepted purpose. Its project has public functional conditions and an effect on the world. Dialogue alone cannot make Rill independent. Once a project is achieved, her response must be capable of changing what she seeks or what the shared speaker does; not another fixed “own act” flag.

4. **Make grants and a shared speaker actual capabilities.** A durable grant changes who can revise, withhold or transform a work, and can let the recipient safely undertake its own project. Stable common reference can enable a joint act no isolated local will can perform. Binding can preserve that reference across incompatible local changes, while limiting unilateral revision. A revisable association can preserve local authorship but cannot promise the same singular answer under every disagreement. These are causal distinctions to implement and counterexample, not points awarded for authoritarianism or consent. If free invitation performs every attractive joint act with all the same guarantees, discard the supposed dilemma. Likewise, test whether making a separate copy with every possible right trivially satisfies everyone: preserving a lineage and sharing one accountable identity must have different effects if the model claims a dilemma between them.

5. **Allow authored arrangements.** The player may separate exact private addresses from public interpretations, combine local and shared jurisdictions, route a reply through translation, or decline the shared project. Do not reduce the new operator to choosing “unity” or “pluralism” in a menu. The world must expose intermediate constructions and consequences.

Long intervention 40 guarantees memory under custody; adopted authority arriving over the bridge becomes imposed and compels Mneme despite his accepted invitation. candidate_passages.text: This contract records the user's corrections after the first flood prototype. It is a current design constraint, rather than a conclusion inferred from automated scores.

The owner clarified after trying the written Bell Orchard and Mneme prototypes: “I don't really want much text narrative at all” and “Any narrative we find must be emergent in the primitives of the game.” Narrative sweep, beauty, philosophical concepts and curiosity remain motivations. The desired vehicle is the game's building blocks: terrain, an avatar, a foe indicator, a changing block or another visible process. Authored dialogue and successive prose scenes are not the current direction. Preserve those experiments as history rather than treating their agent appreciation as evidence of owner fit.

The owner specifically finds combining onto terrain promising. A place can participate in the operation, including as a catalyst in **A + B at P**. Its properties may enable a combination or change its effect; the place persists. This is a hypothesis to test, not a mandatory ternary grammar for every level. Where place or time is used to produce history, it should contribute actual causal rules, with earlier constructions changing later possibilities. Time may be a process or context; it need not become an action allowance. Shared-ontology levels do not require a persistent simulation or a narrative arc.

The next logical tests should expose the concepts, relations and functional transitions that make a level's goal worth working toward. Where history is claimed, the same primitives must enact it. Compact goals, labels and explanations of actual state are useful. A dramatic paragraph cannot substitute for a world event or a persistent actor's changed behavior. UI polish remains deferred while the game laws are investigated.

The desired experience is creating a universe from its elements. Creating a capability should expand the ways the player can shape what happens. Challenge may arise from consequences, relationships, placement, sequence or execution. Managing supplies must not become a surrogate for that challenge.

The first finite-supply joining experiment violated this preference. Its resource-dependent planning results are rejected evidence for the requested game, and are archived separately. Unlimited joining can still be inspected as a spatial hypothesis, but an abstract shape puzzle has not established the desired creation experience. It remains a staged experiment.

**Rejection test: a challenge must remain worthwhile when every legal combination and its result can be inspected.** If explaining the recipes dissolves the challenge, the design is relying on the low-level search this project intends to remove. The worthwhile work can concern choosing which concepts and multi-step construction realize a goal; choosing when, where, in which order or under which conditions to combine; predicting and adapting to the consequences; or executing a manipulation skill.

A removal of per-partner result names was queued from the agent report, then cancelled before implementation in response to the user. The original affordance is retained. This is a concrete error signal for the evaluator: agency/curiosity proxies must not automatically reject information that a player finds enabling. Keep the authored-ontology problem distinct from tactical uncertainty.

The user feedback is real human design-review evidence about this feature. It is not a recruited multi-person playtest, proof that the whole game is fun, or evidence that any particular challenge works. Earlier reports stating human participants0 describe the earlier experiment period; they must not erase this subsequent feedback.

headings: Locations and chapters have different jobs
Understand from the task and visible things
Goals express the next useful action
Chapters belong to a continuing story
Chapters react to work already done
146301b5bfc8e08529a24dfddc252f5b90c5c604.disposition: reference-only: original claims and provenance preserved

candidate_passages.text: - A new chapter in the **same location** keeps every surviving item and the player's layout. The chapter boundary must never automatically carry/import earlier-area items, prune items, rearrange the work surface or re-grant existing stock. It does not start a fresh board or pretend to travel.

- Normal partner highlighting is a core affordance: show it on press/selection and throughout a thing-drag, including location operands and relevant current-goal things. Location frames are fixed targets, not draggable things. Show legal existing partners and valid drops, not future output-name previews. Highlights must not disappear merely because a source is gold or a target is a location; they must not promise an illegal direction or an already-existing result.

- Never create another C when that output already exists, including in an earlier area or fitted construction. Moving, fitting or incorporating an output is not permission to reconstruct a duplicate. Alternative routes should converge on existing output identities where appropriate; distinct real objects in different kitchens can still share a familiar label.

- After a successful creation, surviving dragged A returns to its original position; B stays put. New C appears close to the receiving B, or **inside the location target** when the location is the operand, and remains portable rather than permanently attached. The explicit transformation and installation rules below take precedence over this ordinary birth rule. A same-token drop is a no-op/rejection, never deletion.

Clear, simple object names are a mandatory baseline, not an optional polish pass. Assume the player skips chapter prose, cache narrative, item descriptions and Read. The task list, object/location names, text printed on tiles, visible fitted components and normal interaction feedback must make the action intelligible. A short quotation already printed on a tile counts; a crucial premise hidden behind Read does not.

- A key quotation can be the item itself: 5–12 words need not collapse into an icon. All long labels—including observations and cases—need matching line space in tile rendering and engine packing. Reserve the reader for fuller source context; never attach fake readings just to obtain text space.
- Celebrate an actually achieved invention. An unfinished Rover shell is not a working Rover; required fitted parts and the authored capability must be present before celebrating it.

- Keep ordinary combinations uncelebrated and never replay an old-save backlog as newly earned. A dismissed celebration happens once per run. Pending rewards and acknowledgement survive saving; Undo removes unearned pending events but does not repeat a dismissed triumph. Reset starts a fresh run; debug checkpoints identify their replayed achievements as historical.

- Each recipe explicitly declares every object input as `transform`, `incorporate`, or `retain`, with a reason. An upgrade or physical incorporation consumes its original at the event when no independent use needs an outside copy; reusable tools and supplies remain when another use still needs them. This is not a finite-stock simulation or a blanket everything-stays rule. Exhausting an input's future uses is a warning to review its lifecycle, never permission to delete it automatically.

- Adding to a fitted rover should keep the same recognisable rover and its fitted parts. Prefer installation in its existing slots. Never collapse a compound into an apparently simple object. When joining assemblies or genuinely changing an assembly's identity, explicitly preserve and display its existing components through subsequent transformations. A change of name is not a disassembly.

- An enhanced thing satisfies the function it genuinely retains: an upgraded radio or growing shelter must not fail merely because its name changed. Preserve real functional distinctions; a radio's little supply is not automatically a rover's traction power. No exact-name barrier should manufacture extra work.

- Every non-opening chapter must meaningfully use at least one, preferably several, objects or ideas created in an earlier chapter. An item merely remaining in inventory, or an old raw supply, does not satisfy this.

- Distinguish actual new supplies spatially: existing objects above a dotted “new items” line, actual deliveries below. Do not use New/Carried labels or divide the screen into arbitrary halves. Compact empty vertical gaps only when needed; allow dense scenes to scroll. The first intentional committed crossing or successful cross-group combination removes the line; cancellation, rejection, reading, resizing and reload do not. Undo restores the earlier split. The lower group contains only this arrival's actual fresh grants, never old-area spillover or existing things reclassified as new. Crossing is scoped to those groups in that area. With no fresh delivery, do not add a divider or rearrange settled objects; old saves are not retroactively relaid out.

- A kitchen or cooking station should support several services, with ordinary ingredients and tools introduced when its stores become available, not a fresh box of bespoke materials for each chapter. Keep the active work area manageable; a substantial facility may have small, clearly established workrooms. New chapters on the same work surface must not repack or relocate settled objects.

- Entering a skipped chapter still introduces its genuine caches and locations. Supplies remain tangible with their original provenance and new-versus-old classification through a cascade; never fabricate combinations or invention rewards. Empty source areas do not retain a delivery divider.

- Every recipe should earn its place through a meaningful, recognisable result or use, not graph padding. Every non-opening chapter must meet the earlier-created-item continuity rule above; merely carrying an item is not meaningful reuse. Historical influence, analogy and physical lifecycle are different claims and need different evidence.

- Grade **factual/authenticity accuracy** and **forward player intuition/useful purpose** separately. A historically or physically defensible account can still fail the player-facing test; an authenticity reviewer must not approve a contrived recipe merely because it can be explained afterwards.

Historical contracts remain intact. In particular, old automatic-hiding rules, permanent past-stage gold, compulsory equipment-delivery chores, chapter-equals-travel assumptions, and the proposed alternating Mars narrators are superseded where they conflict with this document. Frozen source manifests and test evidence describe their pinned revisions; update current behaviour through an explicit successor, never rewrite an old audit to claim it already proved the new direction.

candidate_passages.text: The intended experience is **feeling inventive through understandable, consequential constructions**. The harness evaluates evidence for that experience, suggests a falsifiable change, and compares the change with its baseline. Its output is a set of supported, concerning, and unknown claims. Human enjoyment remains an unvalidated hypothesis until people play.

| **Greg Costikyan, 2002 revision**, [I Have No Words & I Must Design](https://worrydream.com/refs/Costikyan_2002_-_I_Have_No_Words_and_I_Must_Design.pdf). Read proceedings text, especially goals, struggle, and balance; mirror of original paper. | Goal-directed interaction requires obstacles; solitaire balance gives mastery a reasonable chance to improve success. Also describes pleasures beyond challenge. | Compare informed planning with immediate relief and random action, then inspect where skill changes the result. | A designer's conceptual position, not a validated enjoyment scale. Difficulty can increase while agency or pleasure declines. |

These accounts pull in different directions. Efficient mastery might end curiosity; an obstacle might create triumph or merely consume time; a varied trace might express creativity or random wandering. The grader must retain those contradictions. The broader research synthesis supplies competing aesthetic targets; this contract operationalizes the current target only.

Allowed statuses: `support`, `concern`, `unknown`. Allowed evidence kinds: `measurement`, `prediction`, `player-report`, `evaluator-interpretation`, `human-report`. A support claim must cite a real run and turn. No evidence yields unknown. A positive card needs an explicit attempted counterexample or a next counterexample to run. Preserve negative evidence even when a variant is kept.

| **Expressive alternatives** | Players deliberately pursue different constructions that have distinguishable costs or consequences. | All successful paths are cosmetic reorderings of one chain; exploration always loses. | Diversity-seeking agents manufacture novelty that ordinary goal-seeking players would never choose. |

Baseline algorithms and planning agents must receive equal legal offers. A one-step preview available in the browser is fair; multi-step transition calls are privileged unless the browser gives the same capability. Do not describe an algorithm using internal transition search as blind merely because it ignores some fields.

Reserve a separate named holdout seed set before tuning. Evaluate it only after selecting a candidate. If holdout results cause a redesign, mark those seeds as exposed and create a new holdout. Scenario seeds must alter a meaningful condition such as threat position, terrain, objective position, or timing. Merely reordering a menu is an offer-order control, not scenario variety.

Every result table reports actual counts. Keep incomplete games, illegal-action attempts, timeouts, and action-budget exhaustion visible. Never relabel an exhausted search or player allowance as an ordinary game loss.

Group actions by outcome-relevant effects. Two names that lead to the same relevant state are one alternative for this inspection. An evaluator may use privileged search to establish viability but must explain the public cue by which a player could reasonably consider that move.

Before an iteration, write a hypothesis and a prediction about behavior. Example: **discover-and-deploy in one action will increase immediate experimentation and reduce setup losses, but may erase the relief-versus-development tradeoff.** Choose a matched baseline, change that major factor, and preserve both variants.

candidate_passages.text: 1. Every physical combination leaves an inexhaustible **trace**: its actual operands, primitive eligibility guard, relative place/link footprint and provenance. Traces reference source history; transferring one never invents history at its destination.

- **Downstream clay receiving exact A:** fire-first C retains A; subsequently rooting B fragments future arrivals, but C keeps its earlier copy. Root-first B fragments A before C is fired, so C never acquires that exact copy. Both procedures finish with rooted B and fired C. Their different histories remain consequential.

**Attacks:** harmless gardening plus isolation could satisfy every ambition; “fire everywhere first” might dominate both orders. Test these immediately. A universal procedure achieving every valued result means automation followed by closure. This engine does not yet justify180–240 opportunities; further faculties must create different relationships in this world, not more destinations.

**Keep the player's combination concrete.** The constructed output is a faculty or procedure. Its operands must be an actual trace and Memory, or two learned faculties, with the place participating. A command such as “make a garden at C” would instead select a finished result and commission its construction. Maker activity is the consequence of creating its faculty, not a substitute for the player’s act. If most later play becomes selecting destinations and watching known macros, the intended interaction has weakened.

**Transfer behavior, not a permission key or a fabricated past.** Trace provenance may identify the old crossing, but provenance alone cannot earn causal transfer. The procedure must preserve the recorded primitive operation and its spatial dependency. Destination memories, routes and arrivals must be read from the actual destination. Channel/fork/basin catalysts would count only if channel succession, guarded branching or feedback actually change execution; merely enabling the same procedure would not establish the proposed qualitative change.

**Smallest functional test:** record one actual player combination that activates a broadcast, then physically combine that trace with Memory at the maker. Apply the learned operation in two recipient histories made by legal prefixes: identical fired, nonbroadcasting surfaces with current fragment arrivals, one having actually retained exact A earlier and one never having received it. The same taught operation must republish exact A only in the first history. The second must broadcast fragments, not inherit the teacher’s A. Connect an unrooted, unfired clay neighbor: exact republication should flood it; fragment-only flow should leave it passable. This avoids relying on a soil neighbor that may already have rooted autonomously. The changed walkability makes the causal transfer affect later behavior. Test this before adding procedure composition or a campaign.

**Bold experience hypothesis:** “I made a garden; can I make a gardener I trust around the home we share?” The interest would come from granting usable agency to a familiar counterpart, seeing its real effects on a valued old place, then wanting to teach or compose something different. A deterministic procedure is not evidence of consciousness or independently felt values. Adoption of this project remains to be tested; no request queue should supply it by default.

candidate_passages.text: The strongest short-game evidence so far concerns useful distinctions between purposes, retained constructions, and complementary causal methods. It does not validate a speculative society simulator. This document broadens the content hypothesis in response to the user's interest in future society, governance and technology; it does not pretend that method construction alone is the desired intellectual history.

**Playable consequence:** combine the charter with particular actors or uses, changing which prediction-based actions institutions may perform. A system must still admit and serve people outside its forecast. **Tension:** forecasting loses coverage; rights must not become an excuse to abandon the unmodeled. This concerns the fictional institutions' permissions, **not hiding game rules, actor policies or previews from the player**. Blanket refusal and universal surveillance should produce different, inspectable failures under a concrete goal.

**Playable consequence:** combine two rulesets through an explicit interface that exports only specified permissions and obligations. Local differences remain active. **Tension:** universal harmonization erases autonomy; refusing every bridge defeats the common project. Success must come from the actual scope of the treaty, not a numeric diplomacy bonus or a label saying “tolerant.”

**Playable consequence:** combine selected memories or purposes into a shared object while leaving the actors and their independent choices intact; a full merge is another openly specified option, not the automatic superior outcome. **Tension:** shared memory can repair misunderstanding, but forced unity can destroy the very differences a long life produced. “Merge everything” must not satisfy a goal that preserves distinct consent.

Bodies and memories endure while offices, vetoes and ownership-like powers can end. A founder becomes an adviser or ordinary citizen rather than either an eternal ruler or a person who must disappear for others to govern.

**Playable consequence:** bind a learner to a limited, visible mandate, let its public learning policy alter how it acts, and expand or revise the mandate after specified demonstrated relations—not a generic experience-point threshold. **Tension:** apprenticeship can be care or indefinite tutelage. A good construction must allow growth and eventual refusal, while preserving the commitments for which the learner is acting.

**Playable consequence:** combine a civic person with an infrastructure role, then separate ongoing maintenance knowledge from revocable governing powers. Its public actor policy can accept a valid new mandate and refuse an out-of-scope demand. **Tension:** “autonomous infrastructure” must not mean a permanent unelected ruler, while treating every caretaker as disposable property destroys continuity. Test actual changes in permitted behavior, not a renamed automation bonus.

**Playable consequence:** bind transitions of authority to explicit world-state conditions, then let the world's actual development trigger them. **Tension:** stability can protect commitments; automatic transitions can also fire too early, too late or under a misleading proxy. The player must preserve the intended relationship between condition and mandate. These are public causal triggers, not hidden quest eligibility. Also developed in the [independent sketch](future-ideas-independent-sketch.md).

**Playable consequence:** combine a trace with a temporal/sensory translation that changes its experienced rhythm while preserving designated causal breaks and source relationships. A Witness Forest can become an input to an experience, not just a witness in a dispute. **Tension:** compression can make a slow world intelligible while smoothing away the interruption that mattered. The player's translation must produce a visibly changed sequence, not merely award “empathy.” The [independent sketch](future-ideas-independent-sketch.md) develops this artistic, non-governance branch.

The player may learn every concept. That is not the challenge. **Discovery creates a reusable idea; adoption combines it with particular people, roles or places and changes their actual permissions, obligations, actions or state transitions.** Applying every doctrine everywhere should not be a universal safe policy: shared representation can defeat a required independent refusal; unqualified exit can break an existing commitment; a permanent ecological mandate can defeat an intended succession. Do not invent an exception only to thwart saturation. Such conflicts must follow the disclosed meaning of the combined ideas.

An additional alternative from the independent sketch is **The Epoch Concordat**: Constitutional Seasons + an Asynchronous Republic (federalism combined with delay-tolerant communication). It carries promises across both institutional transitions and the inability to share a present. It is an alternative to the regrowth federation, not another required upgrade. A later prototype must model the communication delay and lawful succession before claiming that this idea does more than rename a treaty.
## Smallest useful implementation hypothesis—not a broad speculative simulator

**What would falsify it:** every goal is solved by “copy, give everyone every right, merge everything”; actors never do anything beyond satisfying tags; the operations become ledger bookkeeping; or the only appeal comes from long prose about unimplemented lives. Test these before a browser or a large campaign. Preserve short successful solutions and the possibility that clear familiar actions are worthwhile. Do not claim that eighteen evocative nodes establish fun or 200 decisions.

A second viable slice is **Witness Forests → Ecological Embassies → Constitutional Seasons → Federations of Regrowth**, provided the ecological traces, phase changes and jurisdictional transitions actually occur through reusable laws. It could produce a visibly changing world; it also risks becoming renamed flow-network management or another provenance worksheet. Those are reasons for a cheap falsifiable prototype, not grounds for claiming success now.

A compatible contact preview must reveal the exact resulting relation **and the actor/world response it enables**. After a combine, deterministic public actor policies settle: the caretaker actually opens or maintains the gate; an unbound willing relative actually joins the expedition; an overbroad proposal is actually refused. Automatic responses are not counted as player decisions. No periodic gate-closing chore or deadline is introduced to manufacture length. Concepts remain inexhaustible and old inputs remain inspectable.

3. **One voice for one purpose:** form a shared representation for revising the old garden promise, while an expedition decision still requires the expedition participant's own consent. The prior knowledge-sharing construction must remain useful; no need to reconstruct it.

Checks must evaluate actual permissions, actor actions and world state, not expected concept IDs or a “good society” score. The public interface should expose these predicates in ordinary language; the code assertions are an implementation contract, not a player walkthrough.

V2's short provenance game and V3's short causal-method game remain frozen, reviewed evidence. The [multi-inquiry proposal](ideas-history-campaign-proposal.md) remains an available method-focused branch, but it is **not the sole future direction** after the user's SMAC-inspired request. This ontology explicitly introduces personhood, governance, succession and ecological representation. No broad future-society model or second browser game has been implemented from it. The independent [creative sketch](future-ideas-independent-sketch.md) offers additional alternatives; selecting among them is still a research decision.

candidate_passages.text: * `attach` joins actual assemblies, or an actual assembly and a known design. The second actual assembly retains its existing pose unless a complete `at` pose is supplied. A design operand is instantiated at the supplied pose. The result must physically touch and avoid collision. `toolPart` may select the actual contact part in the attached subtree; this persistent part-specific joint must remain touching after later material or hinge changes, even when both disconnected pieces would separately have floor support. `parent` optionally selects the host part; `hinge` optionally declares a real pivot/axis in that parent's local coordinates. `detach` selects an actual nonroot subtree. `discard` removes a selected actual assembly; replacement is legal.

* `transform` selects actual material `part`, a compatible catalyst/tool and a disclosed `recipe`. Actual tools use `toolPart`, never their host's identity. The selected local material and actual tool must currently share positive-area face contact; remote objects and unrelated host parts cannot substitute. A complete `at`/`rotation` can place the material assembly in that same transformation selection. Inexhaustible primitive catalyst capabilities are hand tools; actual site water requires local contact. `fit` seats an actual local matching surface at a disclosed site. `sample` takes an actual tray/site contact sample.

Units: x east, y south, z up. Root trays, lenses and recording plates are actual unit cube bodies. Thin roofs and frame struts have zero thickness as an explicit geometric abstraction. Distinct solids cannot overlap; panels cannot cut their interiors. Touching faces and coplanar thin laminates are legal. Every shape must connect through actual geometric contact to the unbounded supported z=0 apron. The apron has no inventory or object cap.

A lens looks along its local +x. Its optical center is the unit body's center; the actual plate center must be exactly one unit behind, with its local +x recording normal pointing in the same direction as the lens. The subject must lie on the front-on cardinal ray with its front facing the lens. Both the target-to-lens and lens-to-selected-plate focal paths are checked. Only the selected lens and its selected recording plate are excluded from occlusion; opaque/diffuse/reflective siblings still block. Every faithful record freezes actual center, heading, target front, lens/plate IDs and intervening clear surfaces on both paths (separate immutable `focalBoundaries` snapshots). Copies and replacement cameras may establish the same common-center comparison; there is no camera-ID requirement.

All processes, input properties and geometry are public in the catalogue. Design copies preserve material and geometry but clear all actual observations, contact samples, histories and active seats. Physical impressions/copies retain actual selected source observations, never the identity of an unrelated containing host or receiver. A real mesh template supplies its actual local shape dimensions, in the receiving material's local orientation; its host identity is not substituted for the selected part.

Station continuity is event-linked, not a named original quota: a player-chosen moldable porous surface must genuinely feed a growing bed before that same local material is made into a durable watertight recorded artifact. A replacement can keep supplying water. A historical fitting stamp alone is not useful service. Copying that design does not copy its earned history.

Day seeks the nearest Light. Night seeks the nearest Shade. A creature at its preferred source stays. Equally near preferred sources cause visible hesitation. The earlier flood dashboard was hard to understand, and its output-first recipe cards made combination incidental. The user asked for a stock of things beside a free play area and for visceral handling of the ingredients themselves.

The change is intentionally substantial: the default is now the tactile table. The flood game remains at `?experiment=flood` as a baseline, rather than a template the new game must preserve. [Current design contract](design-contract.md).

The default includes the earlier small concept graph so that this experiment need not invent new content to test the gesture. It has no storm, turn budget or completion objective. Consequently it can test handling and discoverability, but it does not establish the intellectual/skill challenge requested for a finished game. Those surrounding systems must earn their place separately.

This conflicts with the agent's negative interpretation of pervasive result labels. Removing those labels was queued, then **cancelled before implementation**. The affordance is preserved. The grader must retain this counterexample: an AI may mistake enabling information for lost agency. Agent consensus or an elegant proxy cannot override direct player evidence about what they found useful.

This is real feedback from one human project owner, not a formal recruited playtest or proof of complete-game enjoyment. It is stronger evidence about the owner's preferred discoverability than the agent's speculation. It does not establish reaction timing, long-term challenge, skill transfer or enjoyment for other people.

The challenge must survive full recipe information. Reject a design that becomes difficult chiefly by hiding its combinations, asks the player to issue finished-output instructions, or adds repetitive preparation with no meaningful choice. Browser agents can expose interaction errors; actual human handling remains necessary to judge the desired visceral experience.

candidate_passages.text: The owner asked whether each level would be extremely narrative-heavy, then explicitly proposed ontology-heavy levels: a huge combination tree reused between levels with different goals. We interpret the dictated final clause as a different goal within the shared sea of combinations, not a demand for simulation, permanent world state or endless play.

Our recent prototypes overemphasized making each world generate its own next purpose. That is one legitimate hypothesis, not the test every level must pass. A bounded goal can organize the player's work, and satisfied completion can be a successful ending. Another level may supply the next purpose without authored drama.

| Primitive-generated development reads as a requirement for every candidate | Combination must carry the activity; any narrative must arise in primitives, but every level need not generate a narrative |

Compare three things: **semantics** (what the combination does), **skill** (what the player must work out), and **consequences** (what changes afterward). Joining a shape, transforming a living material and binding independent councils are candidate differences. Renaming shapes as ideas is not sufficient to establish a new inference, but the ideas may still contribute conceptual value; test that claim separately. Different truth tables can still invite the same familiar construction method. Conversely, the same familiar method can acquire a new significance through a different level goal or the history of a developing world. Ask what transferred and what required a new inference; do not equate new vocabulary or an authored chapter with a new kind of play.
These IDs are an audit contract, not a checklist that every game must score positively on.

| F1 | State the proposed pleasure and scope | Declare decision, insight, exploration, expression or valued repetition; specify bounded level, cross-level sequence or continuing-world hypothesis, its counterevidence and project fit | Treating every level as a self-renewing sandbox, or appreciation as approval of the vehicle |
| F9 | Close the loop | Give a source-linked hypothesis, actual test, counterevidence, revision and a new test | Static judgments that do not change after play |

For a candidate that specifically claims a long developing world, test whether interacting laws, retained creations, opposition or processes sustain meaningful activity over that declared scope. A large map, scene list or menu does not establish it. For a goal-led sequence, explicit new objectives may supply purpose; they need not emerge from the previous world's history. Either route must earn the attention it asks for, without padded repair or ceremonial combinations.

For each played candidate, keep a reviewed ledger of which experience hypotheses to retain, change, reject or leave untested, with supporting and opposing trace references and a new falsifiable experiment. Copying the designer's pre-play next-test sentence is not closing the loop.

Verify elective construction against a valid earlier checkpoint and recorded intention. Keep a chronological choice log; distinguish continued construction, optional inspection, choosing closure and required action. A linked new session must have prospective provenance, not merely an arbitrary matching filename. These checks establish protocol behavior, never intrinsic human motivation.

The next cycle should test a representative connected ontology slice under different explicit goals, with public recipes, inexhaustible established concepts and actual player combinations. Declare each level's proposed pleasure and ending, compare which construction work the goals elicit, and test transferred understanding separately from optional appetite. A continuing-world experiment remains legitimate when it is the declared hypothesis, not an obligation imposed on every slice.
