candidate_passages.text: Working model, revision 9, revised on 26 October 2026 after the owner's 05:40 UTC correction: clear progress can be comfortable, and learning the mechanics can supply part of an opening's meaning without every decision being meaningful. Different explicit goals within a shared ontology remain a central route; any narrative still belongs in the game's primitives rather than authored prose scenes. This document is a design hypothesis to improve through play, not a definition of every kind of fun or a validated measure of human enjoyment. UI work remains frozen. The [unchanged revision 8](history/what-is-fun/revision-8.md), [revision 9 review](history/what-is-fun/review-9.md), earlier revisions and the [source review](interesting-decisions-research.md#independent-review-of-what-is-funmd-revision-1-before-application) preserve the changes. The [dated Mars postplay addendum](mars-objects-opening-interpretation-2026-10-26.md) separates this correction from the frozen plays.

The owner has identified **narrative sweep, beauty, philosophical resonance and the hook of discovering what comes next** as central personal motivations, citing their experience of Psychonauts 2. An earlier clarification specified the narrative vehicle: “I don't really want much text narrative at all. Any narrative we find must be emergent in the primitives of the game.” These are compatible preferences. A history of what the player made, what it changed and what answered it can have sweep and meaning without dialogue, chapters or a supplied character mystery carrying the experience. This is an option for creating value, not a requirement for a narrative-heavy level.

The owner specifically values combinations applied to the map: **a place in the terrain is itself a thing that can be combined with other things**. A character's avatar, a foe indicator or a Tetris block can express an event through the game's building blocks. Spatial worlds, recognizable actors and opposition remain valid design materials, not mandatory ingredients in every level. The correction does not request an unthemed algebra or the removal of characters. Logical models should establish the state, relations and changes that could eventually be visible; this is not authorization to resume UI work.

The current generative hypothesis is: **fun can arise when the player learns how the game works, makes clear progress, or adopts and realizes an intention through combining.** Devising a construction and valuing its consequences remain important possibilities; they are not the only ones. Comfortable progress need not hide a strategic dilemma, a new insight or a new purpose in every action. Wanting to act again is a further hypothesis, not a universal condition of a successful level. The next purpose may be generated by the world, chosen by the player, or explicitly supplied by another level. Intelligent action and victory alone establish neither enjoyment nor appetite.

A game can offer a developing relationship between a player and a world, rather than a series of individually defensible decisions. Anticipating and repairing disorder, pursuing an ambition against opposition, and growing from a small world into astonishing powers remain experience engines to investigate. If a developing relationship is claimed, it must be enacted by the system rather than principally supplied by its account of what a character supposedly feels. A bounded construction challenge need not make that claim.

The owner's shared-ontology correction is that a level may be **ontology-heavy rather than narrative-heavy**: a huge tree of combinations can be reused between levels, with a different goal in each. This is a legitimate central design route, not a fallback for a sandbox that failed to renew itself. A concise explicit objective can make a portion of that shared possibility space relevant. Completing it can be the successful end of a level; the next level may supply the next purpose without a character arc or emergent emergency.

Before building a large catalogue, test a representative connected slice with several materially different goals. Ask what each goal makes relevant, what the player must work out, what knowledge transfers, and where execution becomes satisfying enactment or unwanted routine. A later level need not introduce a new operator or a wholly new skill to be worthwhile. It should offer the claimed experience, not receive novelty credit merely for changing names.

Place, time and other simple backdrop conditions can contribute to an unfolding history. Time may be a causal context or process: an earlier construction can change what a later phase permits, and a process can leave a visible trace that affects the next intervention. Public timing, growth, recurrence, sequencing or an opponent's continuing action are permissible design materials. Do not conflate them with an arbitrary action quota, a finite resource renamed time, or a deadline added solely to manufacture a tradeoff. Not every prototype must omit time, and time pressure need not be the only source of challenge. The history should be readable in changed state, processes and relationships rather than a sequence of dated paragraphs.

Carry the praised availability logic into terrain operands. Hovering a concept could reveal applicable places and results; hovering a place could reveal combinations supported by its current state. In logical testing, expose the equivalent legal-action predicate, result and relevant conditions. Actual eligibility rules remain public. Searching for arbitrary place-specific recipes or a hidden catalyst condition must not become the challenge. This records a discoverability requirement for the substrate, not a new UI implementation task.
- What must the player work out or skillfully construct, and what worthwhile ambition or opposition gives that work a purpose?

Not every action must traverse this entire loop. Several combines can enact one intention; a satisfying known action can be part of a larger ambition. Nor must every success create another emergency or voluntary project. Relief, appreciation, closure and choosing to stop satisfied are legitimate experiences. Distinguish eager continuation, satisfied completion, boredom, confusion and required compliance. Finishing a goal-directed level without further appetite is not by itself a failure.

There can also be comfort in doing clear things and seeing progress, including after the mechanics are understood. Do not make this value conditional on measurable learning, a changed role, a later payoff or a special claim that each routine act is intrinsically meaningful. Familiar enactment can keep the same purpose. This is the owner's design preference and a prospective hypothesis, not evidence that the existing agents or a hypothetical human enjoyed a particular sequence.

Judge simplicity in relation to the stage and proposed experience. A short orientation, a comfortable passage and a later construction problem can reasonably ask different things of the player. Pacing concerns how these passages feel together, not maximizing strategic dilemmas per combine. Later goals may give familiar actions further purposes; this is one possibility to investigate, not a debt that every early action must repay. Nor must every later passage become harder or novel.

Combining a living process with a preserved form, a record with a place, or a purpose with a persistent actor can suggest different kinds of creation. The concept should have an understandable role in what happens. Expose its local rules; thematic association must not become another hidden password. Philosophical meaning can arise from preserving a memory while changing its audience, or protecting a place at the expense of contact, because the player actually constructed those relations. A speech about memory or freedom cannot establish the corresponding consequence.

The first audit showed why this needs an implementation contract. Different report vocabularies hid the Bell player's quiet-memory appreciation and Mneme player's satisfied closure from the evaluator's summary. Preserve source paths, explicit absence, negative reports and unknown fields. A summary must not turn unrecognized language into missing experience.

The **critic** asks whether the mechanism produced that sequence in play, checks alternatives and rival explanations, and proposes a falsifying next test. The critic must not demand statistical proof before every invention, nor treat uncertainty as a reason to stop designing. A negative finding should narrow or change a mechanism; it should not become an endlessly expanding warning checklist.

Use an elective-interest diagnostic when the hypothesis concerns self-generated projects, continuing-world renewal, or desire to take another level. It is not a universal pass gate for every bounded level. Before such a diagnostic, specify a short required exposure and a genuine stopping point. After the first meaningful response, ask what, if anything, the player wants to attempt next **before suggesting a desirable answer**. Offer stopping as a fully valid way to finish the test. If they choose continuation, record the actual optional action and the intention expressed before it. A promise to play again is weaker evidence than doing so.

The experience account must identify the intended goal or pleasure, the work it required, the resulting construction or response, and the observed completion, continuation or stopping. For a renewal claim, additionally identify the proposed invitation and what the player made of it. If a player performs a clever construction and stops satisfied, that may support a successful finite level; do not call it sustained absorption or reject it for lacking another project. When continuity is the question, a closed-ending/continuing-consequence comparison can help. If several mechanics change at once, do not claim the comparison isolates continuity.

For this project, combining must be central to the activity. Its inputs, their relationship or their order should explain the result. This does not require labeling every individual combine meaningful: clear, familiar execution can be part of worthwhile play without a new reason attached to each step. A recipe catalogue attached to an unrelated ability menu is weak evidence. All legal combinations and their rules may be known. We are not trying to make guessing the author's vocabulary enjoyable.

The owner's Sid Meier proposal remains a decision-making hypothesis, not a requirement governing every passage: an interesting decision is informed, consequential, and presents a worthwhile choice without an obvious universal winner. This is our operational synthesis, not a verbatim Meier definition. His talk allows situational tradeoffs, consequences, understandable information and different play styles, while explicitly acknowledging limits of the decision lens for some puzzles and rhythm games. | Construction/execution | Realizing an understood composition | A fully understood action must be busywork |

The last two rows matter to the owner's hunch: combining may be familiar and repetitive while its meaning changes. The chores paper provides evidence about social board-game activities, not a general validation of solo repetition. Our solo-combining hypothesis needs its own evidence. Ask what repetition is doing for this player and preserve disagreement.

A real game must make both sides arise from the same coherent operation. If the player can harmlessly acquire and apply every safeguard first, the supposed tradeoff has collapsed. That falsifies the tradeoff claim, not automatically a separate insight, construction or expression claim. If one arrangement achieves every valued outcome better, the alternatives may be dominated. If every first move can still reach exactly the same outcomes, the consequential commitment may occur later. Find it rather than declaring every setup action strategic.

Distinct viable outcomes are evidence of a choice structure. They do not show that anyone cares about the difference. Compare alternatives from the same saved state under the same disclosed rules. A truncated search is not proof an alternative is impossible. Conversely, a unique-solution insight puzzle can be worthwhile without a Pareto frontier. A clear answer after the insight does not invalidate the earlier insight. The evaluator must identify which kind of pleasure the candidate claims to offer.
6. **A recommendation:** keep, change or reject one concrete hypothesis, with counterevidence and a next test.

Functional disclosure must include the state and history needed to reason about those laws. If audience attaches to a voice origin, reveal that origin; if a stored record can restore exactness, show the record; if an intermediate event leaves lasting exposure or a changed actor policy, include that consequence in the functional forecast. A compact avatar or indicator may later display such facts, but brevity cannot justify obscuring them. Mystery about an undocumented condition is not the desired curiosity.

The density idea can be useful for a decision-heavy passage: worthwhile decisions can be diluted by unwanted work. It is not an overall pacing target, and low dilemma density cannot by itself reject an opening or comfortable passage. Commands are not time, and an AI's tool latency or deliberation time is not human playtime. Report the numerator, denominator and access condition. Do not rename actions-per-game as interesting-decisions-per-minute. Bundling a solved chain into one command must not automatically improve the attention verdict. Track the claimed experience and valued execution separately.
- An agent reports routine answer selection: keep that report; do not convert the owner's general preference for comfort into this agent's or a human's enjoyment.

A level may reuse the same combination laws for a different explicit goal; it may also change the local meaning of combination if its rules are explicit. A concept's meaning can also change what the player cares about, even when part of the algebra transfers. We need not force geometry, processes, ideas and institutions into the same operator merely to reuse an implementation. A place as an operand or catalyst is a promising way to let context matter; it remains a hypothesis rather than a required wrapper for every experiment.

Compare three things: **semantics** (what the combination does), **skill** (what the player must work out), and **consequences** (what changes afterward). Joining a shape, transforming a living material and binding independent councils are candidate differences. Renaming shapes as ideas is not sufficient to establish a new inference, but the ideas may still contribute conceptual value; test that claim separately. Different truth tables can still invite the same familiar construction method. Conversely, the same familiar method can acquire a new significance through a different level goal or the history of a developing world. Ask what transferred and what required a new inference; do not equate new vocabulary or an authored chapter with a new kind of play.
These IDs are an audit contract, not a checklist that every game must score positively on.
| F9 | Close the loop | Give a source-linked hypothesis, actual test, counterevidence, revision and a new test | Static judgments that do not change after play |

A large map, scene list or menu does not establish it. For a goal-led sequence, explicit new objectives may supply purpose; they need not emerge from the previous world's history. Either route must earn the attention it asks for. Do not add compulsory repetition merely to inflate length, or confuse a player's appreciated familiar enactment with padding.

For each played candidate, keep a reviewed ledger of which experience hypotheses to retain, change, reject or leave untested, with supporting and opposing trace references and a new falsifiable experiment. Copying the designer's pre-play next-test sentence is not closing the loop.

Verify elective construction against a valid earlier checkpoint and recorded intention. Keep a chronological choice log; distinguish continued construction, optional inspection, choosing closure and required action. A linked new session must have prospective provenance, not merely an arbitrary matching filename. These checks establish protocol behavior, never intrinsic human motivation.

Revision5 added the owner's sweep, beauty and philosophical motivations, and revision6 incorporated evaluator audit findings. Revision7 corrects the vehicle: any developing narrative must arise through the primitives and their interaction, with little authored narrative text. Revision8 corrects our overemphasis on each world generating its own next purpose: a large reusable ontology with different explicit level goals is a legitimate core design, and successful finite completion is not an appetite failure. Revision9 corrects our overly negative framing of straightforward early play: learning mechanics and simply making clear progress are legitimate possibilities, without requiring every action to be a meaningful decision or acquire a later purpose. candidate_passages.text: The player combines understandable ideas into reusable capabilities and combines those capabilities with particular people, methods, artifacts and places. A discovery should preview both the new possibility and a concrete example. Not every discovery must be immediately applied, surprising or difficult. The point is a growing vocabulary that changes what the player can make, not seven mandatory philosophy stamps before ordinary water service.
## Research, fiction and evidence must stay separate

All future concepts and the estuary are **authored speculative fiction**. Their parent combinations are intelligible design propositions, not historical derivations or scientific predictions. A source card can say “inspired by joining teaching and observation,” but may not say that an invented recipe caused Edinburgh medicine. Historical provenance must not become the main game merely because it is easy to verify.

Reusable operations include compose, intervene, teach, enact, fork, translate, reconnect and reconfigure. These are not automatically eight equally deep mechanics. Each must earn its place through a changed observable result. Use direct whole-method/whole-agreement actions; do not split authorization into redundant propose/accept/report clicks.

These 27 candidates supply intermediate constructions and cross-links, not 27 guaranteed worthwhile discoveries. Some may collapse together. In particular, Experience Addresses must not become an obligatory citation-stamp operation, and the various apprenticeship names must not require discovering duplicate synonyms to perform one act. An implementation may represent some rows as recipes for methods, not separately named research gates.

**Intermediate roles:** relative → traveller/local practitioner → teacher/recipient. **Retained objects:** the original method and a new expedition episode. **Transfer:** an explanatory method becomes something a person can learn and adapt. **Failure test:** authority settings or lineage alone satisfy the goals; the world never changes because of what either relative learned. No named original actor is mandatory except where an explicitly requested continuity makes identity meaningful.

A trace-bearing grove changes under a disclosed small process model. The project is first to reconstruct a relevant earlier disturbance, then choose a restoration whose actual evolution preserves a stated living feature. Earlier methods can probe the new process. Borrowed Seasons translates its long change into a short performance; a visitor must be able to distinguish two meaningful temporal orders in the enacted score, not merely read a label.

The workshop now hosts residents, a translated performance and ongoing observation. A generation wants a functioning present and two actual later uses: a private retreat and a shared teaching/performance space. The player can rearrange, replace, expand or retain earlier constructions as the public spatial laws allow. The project is not “never demolish” or “keep original object 7.” If replacement and inexhaustible copies make all futures trivial, record the collapse rather than invent a material budget.

A willing resident teaches actual controls of the already useful construction, hands over its hosting role and continues elsewhere. The machine's responses must be enacted on those same parts. A later resident revises the purpose: useful transfer would require adapting a method or applying it to a substantively different task, not replaying another east/west request merely to lengthen the game.

**Intermediate roles:** builder/teacher → learned host → former founder/adviser. **Transfer:** material methods and translated performances become teachable behavior; succession separates continuing knowledge from governing role. **Alternative:** static robust service and direct human operation remain valid ordinary service. Civic autonomy is an explicitly chosen project, not a prerequisite for survival. **Evidence gate:** current live-host pilot tests only the first small bridge. Expansion must wait for whether that bridge is experienced as worthwhile.

The proposed collection offers explanation, enactment, divergence, translation, spatial transformation, learned operation and cooperation. That is a diversity hypothesis, not proof of variety. Persistent people, models and creations must visibly cross those purposes. A later task should explicitly show where an earlier construction is compatible, including a successful shortcut, rather than require rediscovering it.

Normal progression and complete catalogue must use the same worlds, actors and goals. Complete catalogue grants reusable conceptual capabilities, never fabricated episodes, physical service or agreements. The normal route can have pleasant understandable discoveries; it must not require ancestors with no intelligible relation solely to delay the player. A complete-catalogue shortcut measures what discovery contributed, not whether normal progression was automatically illegitimate.

Do not assign a quota of actions per chapter. To approach roughly 200 decisions, the eventual complete experience must have enough interacting purposes and useful transformations that players actually choose substantial construction across the collection. If honest witnesses remain forty or sixty, call it that. Source-exposed long witnesses alone are not experienced length. A full fresh run with sparse chapter-boundary reports and independent replay is necessary before any scale claim.

Await the bounded live-host pilot and independent interpretation. In parallel the larger architecture can be challenged on paper: choose one complete trajectory, mark actual state changes and cross-purpose reuse, and attempt universal static/manual/copy/optional-policy shortcuts. The high-cost unimplemented laws—ecology, embodied temporal translation, reflexive public plans and asynchronous institutions—must not be smuggled in as source-backed facts. Select at most one genuinely new substrate after the evidence, with a finite integrated endpoint and explicit controls, rather than another disconnected five-action illustration.

candidate_passages.text: The starting world deliberately supplies useful authored places and tools. Watchhouse observes Sweep; Mirror Quay observes Sweep through reversed movement; Pilgrim Inlet observes Journey through pressure sensing; Lantern Marsh observes Live C through pressure sensing; Mirror Marsh observes Live C through reversed movement; Storm Archive encounters Later D through reversed movement. These sites are explicit situated experiences, not bags into which a player must bind four fields. Each carries a disclosed callable local practice; placing a person there immediately lives the experience and retains its practice. This is an authored abstraction, not simulated geography. Places differ in actual trajectories and embodied practices. Named time/channel tools are ready capabilities, not unlocked by arbitrary primitive recipes.

Three constructed variants reach all six existing endpoint predicates: woven (21 gestures / 25 substrate commands), whole-tool (20 / 24), personal-teaching (22 / 26), each with two automatic deliveries. These are variants of one authored collection, **not three independent content scenarios**, not minima, not 20–22 interesting decisions, and not evidence toward 200 meaningful decisions. They demonstrate the entire collection can use pairs without retaining the earlier multi-field programming interface. An immediate episode lesson can contain two substrate commands; a reciprocal exchange contains three. Those are still one gesture each.

Further work must test whether players value the named consequences and generate genuinely different continuations, then introduce new content scenarios if justified. Padding this finite collection with gates, repeated visits, assembly of parameter fields, or compulsory clicks to reach 200 is specifically rejected. The next design question is how a created relationship changes later options or meaning, not how many repetitions of these 21 gestures can be recorded.

Normal `compatible` hints return **existing partner IDs and names only**. They do not return the future result name, output trajectory or hypothetical world. Existing pieces and their already-public behavior remain inspectable. `preview` is a developer verification facility with rich future output, not the normal player discovery surface. Any trial given `preview` must be labeled preview-exposed, not discovery play. This distinction follows the latest human preference communicated by the coordinator and supersedes the older result-revealing hover assumption for the next whole-play protocol. No new player protocol or player run is launched by this freeze.

Retained pieces are not a clutter defect by themselves. The human's latest workspace preference welcomes a scrolling playspace becoming a catalogue: old things remain where left while useful ones are dragged into new locations. This logical adapter preserves all pieces; it does not implement spatial persistence or scrolling. Future scenario breadth should be motivated by different situations, never merely by reducing retained-token count or forcing a compact screen.

candidate_passages.text: - The episode-pair encounter really exchanges divergent family experience and enacts replays. It can be an optional convenient whole practice. Direct score replay is already lawful and must not acquire a new compulsory Reciprocity prerequisite.

A plausible non-ceremonial pattern is to construct a **reusable particular instrument**: Institutional Correspondence plus Local School produces a Local role address; address plus a score sends a message. A global `hasConcept` check plus unchanged supplied super-tools fails the design hypothesis. Conversely, creating and then using a functional instrument is not disqualified solely because it takes two combinations.

The all-concepts-known control should remove discovery/assembly pleasure while leaving actual application choices. Its shorter route neither proves invention was meaningless nor licenses artificially lengthening it. A complete-catalogue route, ordinary cooperation, direct replay and whole-method shortcuts must remain lawful.

The current engine delivers a score without forcing its recipient to perform. Therefore “accept the score but decline the performance” can already occur simply because the player never selects that performance. That observation alone cannot justify a new Correspondence by Consent capability.

For the hypothetical node to change the world, a retained recipient policy must affect an otherwise operative invitation process: produce an actual response to the sender, filter/narrow participation or delivery under a public trigger, and leave unrelated services and repertoire intact. “Kinship,” “public office,” “commons,” “consent” and “stewardship” have evocative meanings beyond the existing finite laws. The proposal appropriately marks those limits rather than claiming that a shared history proves legal personhood or that routing proves legitimate authority. Future concepts may have understandable parents and still be contested design propositions. candidate_passages.text: The new hypothesis is **invention followed by consequential reuse**: join understandable ideas, acquire a surprising concrete instrument or social practice, and then decide what to do with it. Making a lens and using it are not inherently redundant. The test is whether the lens has an executable operation, works on different material and leaves something the player can reuse—not whether invention and application happen in one gesture.

The future should feel unfamiliar because ordinary relationships have changed: an experience becomes a medium; a relative can share your past without inheriting your office; an institution can outlive its founder without requiring the founder to die. These are not a ladder from primitive to morally superior civilization. Discovering every institution must not impose it on everyone.

All names, parent pairs and future practices below are **our speculative design propositions**, not predictions or documented intellectual genealogies. A parent arrow means “this combination makes sense in this fiction,” never “these two ideas historically caused this institution.” The [historical source guardrails](ideas-history-sources.md) remain in force; medieval schools, Nobel affiliations and contemporary political institutions are not assigned correctness scores. No new factual attribution requires verification for this original design pass.
- **H — hypothesis:** requires additional state/transition laws, not merely new names or recipes. None is implemented or claimed to have been played.

| 19 H | Reunion Without Erasure + Institutional Correspondence → **Civic Apprenticeship** | A school exchanges demonstrations and counterexamples with a learner; correction changes a specific executable method, not a competence label. Use it for a household controller and for a successor interpreting differently embodied demonstrations. Requires a finite correction/transfer law and remote method payloads. | Current local teaching can retain a method, but no curriculum, correction or remote method transport exists. Repeating a known score must not count as learning an adaptive skill. This node is cut unless two materially different tasks reveal actual learned behavior. |

| 20 H | Fork Kinship + Succession Without Death → **Distributed Stewardship** | A role can divide into explicitly scoped services with different holders while retaining shared institutional history. One relative hosts performances, another receives teaching requests; a later community uses the same practice to separate observation from representation. Requires multiple scopes and deterministic request routing. | Copying a person must not duplicate every mandate or vote. Current engine has one holder per school and no service scopes. This is not a bonus for having more copies. |

| 21 H | Continuing lives + Institutional Correspondence → **Correspondence by Consent** | A standing recipient policy filters an otherwise operative invitation/participation process and returns an observable response to its sender without losing unrelated services. Use it for a score-accepting school that automatically declines hosting requests, or a teaching participant who accepts lessons but refuses appointment requests. Requires an actual request/response process and public policies with effects—not hidden assent or a manual non-action. | Current actors are an authored willing backdrop; receipt is not consent, and no acceptance policy exists. Merely receiving a score and never performing it is already possible: that is **not** a new capability. Without an operative process for the policy to change, cut this node rather than count a consent label. Do not invent forced participation just to make refusal necessary, or insert an obligatory approval click in every invitation. A retained policy applies automatically; an explicit response matters only where it changes a real outcome. |

| 22 H | Succession Without Death + Correspondence by Consent → **Revisable Mandates** | A handover can preserve an ongoing service while successor and affected parties revise its scope. Use it to keep a public performance running while changing its host's teaching remit; use the same revision practice to end a service without deleting the former holder's life. Requires explicit service obligations, responses and transition outcomes. | Current routing alone does not represent a constitution or legitimate governance. “All scopes optional” must not silently satisfy a goal requiring an actual service. Do not manufacture conflict merely to prevent a peaceful solution. |

| 24 H | Ancestral Commons + Reunion Without Erasure → **Federated Memory** | Separate communities exchange selected experience threads without copying entire archives or merging local histories. Use it for a jointly curated work and for mutual teaching while different local collections persist. Requires actual scoped exchange between distinct institutional stores. | “Federated” must not be a decorative word for ordinary score mail. A one-score exchange may already satisfy a simple joint goal; federation earns a node only when its continuing selective behavior changes later uses. No claim of collective consciousness. |

A newly invented instrument must have a public signature and examples: input kinds, actual transform/transition, legal targets and a clear non-example. The player physically combines it with material or constructs the particular practice to apply. There is no separate global “unlock,” “install concept” or “certify success” click. No operation checks that a badge was previously earned instead of checking the actual instrument/structure.

This needs an honest new binary binding: several existing actions currently use fixed site/tool/mailbox pieces. A conceptual combination cannot merely set `hasConcept` and leave those supplied super-tools unchanged. For example, 10's result must really carry its temporal transform; 17's result must carry a role destination rule used by an actual score message. How a reusable social practice takes a role/person as its second operand must be settled on paper before implementation. Do not hide a three-field form behind a two-piece animation or proliferate empty half-assembled authorization objects. A useful particularization, such as a reusable Local-school address that routes every later score, is an object with a continuing function—not a one-use approval stub.

Constructing the address particularizes a reusable operation, like choosing the destination of a transmitter. If it serves only one rote message beside its invention, its experiential value remains unproven. There is no extra institution-accepts-address click. Neither raw engine `send` nor inspecting a concept tree is a player bypass: the future player surface would expose actual constructed instruments. Independent equivalent addressed constructions must remain lawful.

| **Knowledge after office**: a founder leaves the chair, not their life; successor later brings back an experience. | Invent a handover practice and connect it to actual later transmission. Founder may already know the trajectory; new provenance still counts. | Existing v2 purpose. Distinguishes person/history from office. It does not require a formal lesson record, genuinely new skill, copy, or relative successor. |

3. **Whole-method challenge:** Borrowed Seasons must equal its disclosed composition. The world must accept serial, fused and independently equivalent lawful outputs, not a preferred recipe ID. Retain direct family replay and plain role continuity.

4. **Reuse challenge:** give each E method a second concrete source or social setting. If its only use is the goal immediately beside its discovery, label that limitation rather than claim a systemic vocabulary. Reuse need not always be strategic; it can be expressive and pleasurable, but that must be observed later.

candidate_passages.text: The decisive added possibility is **learning a usable relation across viewpoints**, not possessing an episode identifier. A source record, a model, a replay and an executable practice must remain different things, although named combinations can construct one from another.

**Observatory — explain and operate.** A moving light follows a public path. A tracking instrument's orientation determines what it actually sees: visibility is an interval around its orientation, not a success tag. The player combines a sensor with a following practice to make a **Tracking Portrait**: a model plus an executable tracking method. A fixed pose can serve a stationary light and must remain legal. A second small relation provides contrast: a **Held Interval** practice starts on an upward threshold crossing and stops on a downward crossing. It can expose an uninterrupted observation window and coordinate a sustained tone across a performance. Stretching a replay changes that tone's duration; replaying the original timestamps does not follow a differently paced live process. This distinction is actual behavior, not a rule that “art must use Borrowed Seasons.”

candidate_passages.text: **Hypothesis:** combining independent wills can create decisions about what to bind and what to leave independent. Union enables joint action, while its shared policy can become inappropriate for some members. The tradeoff concerns relationships and adaptation, rather than stocks, action credits or a deadline. A founding purpose can survive as an institutional rule after the world changes.

Four towns, A–D, begin with independent councils. A council's members must follow one shared policy, `open` or `shelter`. Each announced climate gives every town an explicit local need. Members vote for their need; a majority chooses the policy for the whole council. A tie preserves the founding voice's **original first-climate purpose**. Combining councils is ordered: the current group containing the left ingredient preserves its founding voice.

These are deliberately restrictive **binding-will** rules. The model does not claim that real societies must impose uniform policy to cooperate. Consultation or federation without that constraint is a different operator and is tested as a counterfactual below. That premise needs player scrutiny; removing an obviously superior real-world arrangement is not by itself a source of fun.

**The safeguard policy preserves the quiet ending.** That is a real acceptable solution for someone who wants independent creations. If disconnection provides everything they want, or optional coupling merely means knowingly breaking a finished toy, change or discard the design. Do not convert available combinations or recognition diversity into a fun score or a duration claim.

The new whole-form capability and history-dependent recipes were not needed for the aim and were not used afterward. No specific coupling experiment was wanted enough to disturb the quiet ending. This falsifies the present optional-coupling invitation for this player; it does not establish that timing, history or process composition cannot support a game. The next design needs an independently valued relationship between processes or a continuing counterpart, rather than more available circuit features. This is AI protocol evidence, with no human duration claim.

Three isolated three-action puzzles do not satisfy this requirement. Nor does making a player click through more text. Success would not be merely completing a long script. candidate_passages.text: The owner's explicit target is the **logic of a combination game judged fun and lasting about 200 decisions, preferably across multiple levels/scenarios**. Their further correction is equally binding: clear progress can be comfortable; not every decision must be meaningful; learning the mechanics can supply part of an opening's meaning. [Revision 9](what-is-fun.md) and the [design contract](design-contract.md) govern this protocol.

- [Confluence](confluence-play-review.md) ended at 42 constructive interventions; [Frontier](frontier-play-review.md) at 36 combines plus 12 waits. Their appreciated endings were not roughly-200 results. Automatic events and diagnostic waits must not inflate the claim.

- The [Mars correction](mars-objects-opening-interpretation-2026-10-26.md) prohibits equating obvious actions with a poor opening or the owner's general preference with a particular player's reported comfort.

| B: replication | Another fresh player gets the same version, starts and neutral assignment, without A's record. | Whether A's result depends on one interpretation or inefficient path. Keep the default order for clean replication; if an alternate order is the hypothesis, preregister it and report the confound. |

One independent skeptical reviewer audits all three after play; the reviewer must not be the model/protocol implementer or one of these players. Independence is of role and exposure, not a claim of statistical independence among similar models. Three players are a small qualitative cohort, not a vote estimating human enjoyment.

Run A as the first pilot. If it exposes a broken interface, disclosure problem, unmistakable padding or a whole-campaign short solution, fix the concrete problem in a **new version** before spending B and C on replication. Preserve A as that version's result. If A is viable, finish the planned cohort before declaring success. Do not recruit repeatedly until favorable reports outvote negative ones; further sessions need a named unresolved hypothesis and frozen condition.

- Count another consequential in-world action, including an intentionally chosen wait, as one intervention when it is genuinely selected by the player. A wait of ten beats is at most **one** timing decision, never ten. Record combines, other actions and waits separately; combinations must still carry the proposed game rather than becoming a pretext for a waiting exercise.

The reviewer marks disputed classifications with their trace indices and reports a conservative supported count and an inclusive disputed count. Report total accepted combines even when their decision status is disputed. Do not silently promote 200 commands into 200 decisions, or demote all simple enactment because it lacks new strategy. A count alone never resolves whether the length was welcome.

Examples: 20 selected combines plus 180 automatic ticks is **20**, not 200. A 200-combine selected construction can meet scale while failing the appreciation/pacing question. A 200-combine run governed by ten larger plans can be reported as 200 selected game actions and ten thought episodes, without claiming 200 dilemmas. A valid 20-action campaign solution is a good or bad **20-action result**, never a 200-action success because the unused catalogue is large.
per-session scale and value judgment; one keep/change/reject hypothesis

Test reviewer-only shortcuts after preserving the player evidence. Label privileged search separately from public-information reasoning; neither is a fresh play. A structural counterexample qualifies the claim without erasing a player's genuine report of value. A shorter expert solution does not automatically make a novice's appreciated play padding: state the inference required, prior expertise and intended audience. A short goal-insensitive routine is a different threat from a clever compression of substantial construction work. If the reviewer authored a repair, a subsequent verification must not be described as independent of that repair.

C stopping satisfied after one short level does not invalidate a finite campaign; C continuing does not rescue A/B ending far short or reporting mostly unwanted work. A shorter valid solution is never a protocol violation. If it materially changes the plausible campaign scale, keep the solution, report the short-game success separately and improve the next candidate rather than imposing a minimum number of moves. Likewise, a long tedious campaign reaches length but not the joint target.

If the conjunction is not supported, continue the authorized build–play–review loop with a **new falsifiable change**: add a genuinely useful goal/capability when scope is short, remove/reframe unwanted work when pacing fails, or repair information when reasoning was blocked. Do not endlessly rerun identical prompts, hide easy solutions, or require further optional play to stretch an exhausted world. When the conjunction is supported, publish the qualified result and remaining human/UI questions; do not redefine success as infinite elective continuation.

candidate_passages.text: Yes, as a hypothesis. The relevant graph is recognizable equipment → actual constituent/subassembly → a new useful arrangement. An intact cooling unit can supply a pump and hose; its shell can protect something else; a habitat window can shelter a bed; a blanket can shade, reflect or line depending on its actual properties. These are more intelligible connections than unrelated recipe islands or a series of “advanced” labels.

The receiving-site relationship gives that equipment a possible changed purpose. A pump formerly moving coolant may now supply a higher growing interface, while the casing or heat-exchange structure participates in a dry workspace. Shared materials and components can support comfortable construction even when a sophisticated player recognizes the whole solution immediately. No intermediate needs its own mandated late-game goal, and no unused casing must be repurposed for a certificate.

The new variety must come from what devices can do in different situations, not more copies of finished water/heat/cover installations. The architecture identifies promising families; it has not yet specified enough distinct situations or actual complete routes to establish sustained scope.

1. **Define what is known, visible and reusable.** Inspection should disclose actual contents and consequences, not conceal a useful component until arbitrary dismantling. If one physical separation exposes a new reusable subassembly capability, say so prospectively. Never require repeated salvage after that capability is known. Inspection itself is not a gameplay count.

3. **Specify real faults rather than a repair itinerary.** A missing connection, exposed boundary or visibly unsuitable geometry can justify a repair. A generic broken flag or mandatory original repair cannot substitute for a missing function. State which actual material/geometry properties copies preserve; copying must not mysteriously heal faults or create past service.

4. **Separate functional properties.** Watertightness, thermal insulation, conductivity and optical transmission are not interchangeable success flags. A clear lining may legitimately have several disclosed properties, but each should act consistently in other arrangements. Forms must affect contact or service, not merely satisfy a canonical name.

5. **Do not grant abilities by renaming components.** A fan or motor is not automatically every generator, turbine or pump. Public work/source ports and geometry must justify the proposed reversal or reuse. This is fictional deterministic logic, not real survival-engineering guidance or a claim that arbitrary real devices are interchangeable.

A passive connection must preserve the actual source's available elevation capability rather than teleport water upward. A compatible operating pump can change that reachability through its disclosed inlet/outlet and drive relation. A conduit, separator or relay must not reset head for free; a source-free cyclic arrangement must not bootstrap work. The sheet must state whether a pump's higher outlet relation is bounded and what actual input enables it, without manufacturing a ladder of pump stages to meet a count.

The previous short result does not show structural impossibility for a large reusable ontology. It supplied advanced heaters, collectors, communication devices and structural components, then asked for relatively few functional outcomes. Much fabrication had already been granted. Its unlimited copies, shared effects, abstract connections and remote placement also legitimately compressed installation. **Small authored scope/high-level starts and structural compression both mattered.** Neither “just add more nouns” nor “inexhaustible capabilities must always produce a tiny game” follows.

A large catalogue is not itself a long experienced game: only useful selected creation, discovery and exploration can establish that. But an expert complete-catalogue shortcut is not proof that ordinary first-time making lacks value. Comfortable, understandable construction is a legitimate hypothesis to test, not an embarrassment requiring a new dilemma at every step.

**The primitive starting tier must be prospective.** A lower-level normal condition can legitimately differ from the earlier advanced-component screen. State its supplies and recoverable objects before deriving routes. Removing every useful recovered device solely because it shortened a previous attempt would be anti-shortcut design; selecting a coherent new starting tier to test material creation is not. Compare raw-start, recovered-component, complete-catalogue and saved-design routes without merging their counts or calling one uniquely correct.

**Property changes need separate definitions.** Watertight does not automatically mean thermally or electrically insulating. Transparent does not automatically mean optically focusing. Conductive metal does not itself specify a working converter. These need not be realistic chemistry, but the game's public predicates must distinguish them. Otherwise a sealing recipe becomes an unexplained bundle of success flags. A material may legitimately carry several properties; each claimed effect should be visible and consistently usable elsewhere.

**Geometry must do the work attributed to it.** A coil, axle, cavity and impeller should have disclosed functional arrangements and interfaces, not hidden named-form quality tags. This does not require detailed manufacturing simulation. Equivalent geometry/material combinations should qualify, and a naturally suitable cavity need not be reshaped for a ceremonial receipt.

**Energy conversions require one coherent direction/source account.** Reversible conversion is an appealing shared idea, but “generator” and “motor” cannot each produce their output merely because a coil/magnet name exists. Explain which actual input enables which output and how the rotor is coupled. Cycles without an external source must not create useful work. Conversely, a direct wind-to-pump shaft must not be forbidden because it bypasses electricity. Source grounding is not an invitation to add fuel inventories or production budgets.

**The electrical branch must offer something besides a longer pump route.** It may serve lamps, heat and present communications, but those consumers need genuinely different visible effects. If the full mission only needs the pump, a more elaborate electrical route can remain an optional construction; it cannot be counted as required scope. If the normal mission uses the branch, shared conversion/distribution should make later uses easier rather than require a separate fabrication tree for every consumer.

However, the architecture must not turn stages A–O into fifteen required objectives, compulsory station visits or a minimum sequence length. The stated chain actually contains branches: direct mechanical drive can omit electrical generation and motor conversion; a recovered housing can omit ceramic fabrication; passive delivery can omit pumping. A familiar physical process can be performed with a complete selected pose in one meaningful action rather than padded with carry/mount/confirm gestures.

The full library need not be implemented to test its central hypothesis. A carefully chosen shared material/form branch plus a real elevation/service difference is a better next test than simultaneously adding eight families. If the direct passive answer solves the mission simply, keep it; a future broader purpose must earn the electrical/optical/mobility branches through useful effects or actual chosen exploration.

**Keep:** the diagnosis of limited authored content and advanced starting vocabulary; reusable property/form families; actual transformations; direct and passive alternatives; comfortable making. **Change before implementation:** specify bootstrap tools, independent properties, source/drive semantics and complete alternative routes. **Reject:** numerical scope promises, a mandatory A–O itinerary, new recipe labels without consequences, or treating prior short routes as proof either that the ontology must fail or that merely expanding it must succeed. Human staged-concept praise and agent reuse reports remain motivating but separate evidence, not validation of this new chain.

candidate_passages.text: The hypothesis is modest: clear, individually unsurprising actions can acquire value because they visibly complete a project, and earlier construction continues doing useful work. An action need not introduce a new dilemma to count as worthwhile. The player may enjoy anticipating and enacting an already understood result. Conversely, recording more milestones does not by itself create progression.

Record the first action index at which `gardenNow` is true and the first at which `projectCompleteNow` is true. Both may occur on the same action. These are historical milestone records, not new physical properties. Show both **current** predicates separately from earned milestones. The underlying garden engine's `status: won` must not masquerade as project completion.

“Retaining a functioning garden” means it must function at project completion, **not** that every intermediate step must preserve illumination. Temporary darkening is allowed, accurately disclosed and recoverable; no failure flag or punishment is added. If the player independently keeps it working continuously, record that choice. Do not force a destructive repurposing demonstration.

| Both goals complete in the same installation, especially the universal lit-clear-shell route | Valid purposeful closure; **the staged-persistence hypothesis was not exercised**. Do not count the milestones as two episodes or block that route in a retest. |

Do not spend a second player merely to confirm that retaining a shell saves rebuilding it. If the first player exercises a genuinely incremental path and attributes value specifically to physical continuity, a later matched qualitative comparison becomes useful. Preregister that control separately before running it: both conditions must use the same disclosed final conjunction, ordinary starting catalogue, first garden milestone and reporting questions; the control resets physical installations and observer knowledge once after first garden while retaining known concepts. Disclose that reset in advance. Record its boundary event and account for a simultaneous first-stage success explicitly.

The next research step is therefore implementation and verification of this narrow wrapper, not another design essay, ontology expansion or unsupported claim that persistence makes the game fun. If the pilot never exercises progression, preserve its closure and move to designing a genuinely additional capability/project rather than forcing a second stage from these already sufficient objects.

headings: Independent design review: Mars whole-game synthesis
What is genuinely promising—and what remains only a label
Required next artifact and stopping decision
87fe560856f10c4ff06910bbea9e13187d295c1a.disposition: evidence or protocol: retained with original version and execution limits

candidate_passages.text: **Proceed to one bounded, exact paper specification for adversarial compression—not to implementation, and not on the presumption that the campaign supports about 200 actions.** The proposal has a coherent motivating destination and better potential purpose variation than another archive sequence. Its lawful shortcuts could combine most chapters into one robust distributed camp/network. That may itself be a satisfying substantial creation. The unresolved risk is that the estimated workload and claimed phase progression reduce to much less useful building than proposed—not that a capable universal camp must be defeated. The 145–210 range is an unsupported workload hypothesis, not measured or specified play.

| Be found | Establishing an outward signal can be a clear, short opening with immediate payoff. | What actual line, endpoint and power relation must hold? An exposed mast solving it immediately is acceptable. |

No chapter must contain constant dilemmas. A simple opening and familiar useful enactment can be valuable. But seven motivations do not establish seven independent construction problems, and explicit novelty labels do not establish appreciated novelty.

**2. Unlimited distributed infrastructure can dominate adaptation.** Inexhaustible collectors, transparent covers, clean water branches, relays and independent workshops can make adding modules safer than reconfiguring them. If service is monotone—adding another legal source or relay never harms existing service—a robust universal network is a serious baseline, potentially a satisfying outcome rather than a design flaw. Mere physical collision is insufficient if extra components can be placed on the unbounded apron outside useful rays. If the argument for depth depends on interactions, the exact map must show them rather than assert that supports or beams “may” interfere. Alternatively, substantial varied useful construction and understandable discovery may carry the experience without persistent configuration conflict. Do not cure the problem with inventory, footprint, capacity or ownership limits prohibited by the proposal.

**3. Remote construction can remove the expedition.** The terrace is described as a better base footprint, but its indispensable benefit is not specified. If the player can choose a different regional base, build remotely and convey all sources without a distance consequence, remaining in the basin may meet the actual needs. Conversely, requiring a terrace base regardless of those needs would be a location certificate. For an assigned movement requirement, specify a real destination-dependent service or accept a solution with no expedition. Optional exploration does not need an indispensable mechanical payoff; it can remain available because a player may value seeing and making another place. That value must be observed rather than presumed in the workload total. A one-selection journey should stay one selection; folding, loading, unfolding and repeated trips are not justified merely by naming mobility as a chapter.

**4. Service-link abstraction can erase the proposed spatial problem.** Existing versions permit abstract links and endpoint-only placement. Those abstractions do not validate a new terrain-limited communications network or whole-journey clearance law. The paper sheet must state separately what water, power, heat and communication connections cross, how endpoints make contact, what obstructs them, and whether a known long connection is one complete operation. Otherwise a planner may freely assume either convenient global pipes or inconvenient repeated relay hops to obtain a desired count.

The categories must also become mutually exclusive in the action ledger. A combination that discovers a design, selects its complete pose and performs a transformation is still one selection; it cannot contribute once to each workload row. Inspections, automatic changes, method internals, staged dialogue and checks add no accepted-play length. Normal, complete and saved routes are separate conditions, not components of a sum.

5. A complete ordinary route plus complete-catalogue, rich-saved-assembly, ending-first, remote-duplicate and journey-free alternatives, using exact individually selected operations. Each route must cover the **whole** endpoint, not stitch together attractive local demonstrations.

The synthesis was revised after the initial review. I inspected the final draft at SHA-256 `3561343941f361941878172a96c85fe1fd76cfb91e3a54fb1ac94b5e2d93cd31`; the initial hash above identifies the version that prompted the critique, not this final draft. The revision explicitly labels 145–210 an unsupported speculative workload budget rather than even a counted route estimate, acknowledges the universal-camp and remote-construction alternatives, keeps teaching conditional, and limits the next authorization to falsifying or concretizing the paper arc. These changes address the principal overinterpretation risk; they do not yet supply a map, law, route count or experience result.

**Smallest genuinely new functional contribution to specify:** a **live communications path** through actual endpoints/relays and disclosed terrain occlusion, with source-supported operation and present receiver reachability. It must make distant contact a different purpose from collecting camera observations. Do not implement realistic radio equations, signal-strength budgets, per-tile cable laying or bandwidth economics. Fix a small consistent visible path law and permit alternative chains/placement. The existing optical predicate is an analogy, not validation of this new service.

**Conditional second addition:** actual whole-journey movement through disclosed clearance/support, if ordinary placement plus copies does not already express the route purpose. Geometry need not simulate every wheel step. A new movement law must affect reachable useful configurations and permit bridges/alternate vehicles. If it only adds attach-cart/fold/move/unfold chores, reject it.
| Actual selection class | Design workload hypothesis, not a quota |

This deliberately does **not** promise a 180–240 result: its lower range is short, and the upper end depends on unbuilt content and individually chosen construction rather than cheap saved designs. Even the 65–85 construction estimate needs an explicit useful-capability list; it must not become an instruction to invent 85 compulsory nouns. A comfortable first-time player might make more revisions or alternatives, but inefficiency cannot be the plan for missing length. The current evidence does not justify a stronger numerical claim.

For plausibility, the next complete specification must expose enough distinct useful construction to support roughly 200 without requiring it. If exact normal/complete/saved witnesses collapse below the target band, retain the short result and reassess the **overall campaign scope**, not silently pad it. A larger genuinely distinct scenario can be added only with a new purpose and actual end-to-end test; no arithmetic addition of old independent demos.

6. **Journey removal:** if remote construction and communication satisfy the actual purpose, the nominal expedition cannot be forced by a “must visit” certificate. Either accept the alternative or choose a different honestly movement-dependent purpose.

Capture actual whole play, including comfortable familiar steps, valid early satisfaction, shorter completion, repeated execution, interface limitations and the player's reason for stopping. A new UI may eventually present this through staged places and directly visible pieces; no current UI changes are authorized by this document. Fresh logic testing must not treat unseen polish as part of the experience.

The next paper specification is authorized only as a bounded attempt to **falsify or concretize this complete arc**, not as an automatic path to a new engine. It must give the terrace a real useful relationship or admit that mobility is optional/dispensable. A motivating story does not make a compulsory journey lawful by itself. If a universal connected camp fulfills the proposed endpoint, preserve that answer and report the arc as a simpler construction game.

candidate_passages.text: # Designer research and falsifiable design commitments

- **Learning versus emotional breadth.** Koster and Cook emphasize learning usable models. MDA and Lazzaro give us reason to examine curiosity, expression, relief, and presentation as separate experiences [1–3, 8]. Our grader must allow a strategically legible encounter to remain emotionally flat.

- **Instrumentable behavior versus lived experience.** Cook offers an explicit behavioral model; MDA cautions that components must be assessed through their effects on experience [2, 8]. A replay can show improved prediction. It cannot establish that making that prediction was pleasurable.

- **Prediction to test:** A rules change intended to create anticipation must produce a recognizable change in decisions or pacing, and eventually in player reports. More recipes alone would not satisfy it.

For every judgment, require a build/rules version, seed, decision index, observation, action, resulting event, interpretation, confidence, and a rival interpretation. Treat missing evidence as unknown. Counts of wins, novel recipes, and action variety remain diagnostic context. A mechanical test result must not be relabeled an experience finding.

Historical vocabulary is a source of experiments, not a reason to add a compulsory system.

In **Physics II.3**, Aristotle distinguishes what something comes from, its form, the source of change, and the end for which it is done. Read in [R.P. Hardie and R.K. Gaye's translation](https://classics.mit.edu/Aristotle/physics.2.ii.html), sections2–3. For a made object, these can prompt questions about material, arrangement, making and purpose. The source does not say a finished object must be produced by selecting one item from each of four UI categories.

These are alternatives, not features to combine into one game. Begin with the cheapest interaction that could falsify each. The current tactile workbench can test the shared gesture before any of these surrounding challenges is adopted.
**Falsifier.** Most contact previews require explanation, or all effective constructions are equivalent repeated beams. More pieces or a medieval theme would not cure that.

**The skill.** Ordering transformations and recognizing a useful intermediate state. A culture can act on a suitable mixture, while excessive heat ends its activity. Those are proposed simplified game rules and must be exposed as such, not presented as a food-safety simulation.

**Falsifier.** Players merely follow an authored order, or the process produces progress bars and waiting instead of handling. Correct predictions with no reason to choose a different sequence would also count against it.

**Falsifier.** Players join matching labels without anticipating a consequence, or they spend most of the session reading and issuing abstract goals. A correct proof is not sufficient evidence that handling the ideas is enjoyable.

Archive the flood dashboard as an inspectable failed presentation rather than a template every future game must inherit. First test the bare combining surface. Preserve the input pieces as the most prominent objects, let the possible result appear at contact, and make the merge itself the committed action. Then select one of these challenges through evidence. A small tactile toy may teach us more at this stage than a complex simulation whose combination operation remains incidental.

### A. Transformation-led ontology — preferred first hypothesis

Why this addresses the measured failure: it introduces something to learn and reuse **other than a convenient alias for already-functional primitives**. A pile containing sand, a heater and a frame is not thereby a clear rigid surface; a real transform must occur. That is not an arbitrary extra prerequisite on the old greenhouse if it introduces a new kind of material and new purposes for it. Existing film greenhouses must still work where film is sufficient.

Risk: an opaque recipe checklist can replace an additive checklist. Inspect all results and conditions; permit alternative constructions; never make every named result mandatory. The presence of more transformative verbs still does not establish enjoyable or lengthy play.

Risk: the game becomes packing/engineering work that the user did not ask to make obligatory. It can add burden without adding a valued construction. It also has higher implementation risk than a data-driven transformation result. Do not adopt it merely because it makes the witness longer.

At V1's observed six-ish interventions per goal, something like **thirty-plus genuinely adopted goals**, not twelve labels, is a plausible content order of magnitude. This is a workload inference, not permission to multiply the same solved garden by thirty locations. The content must be specified and played: different desired object states, actual identities, placement relations, observation conditions or constructions. A changed name alone earns no novelty credit; familiar same-role enactment can still earn value through the player's report.
## 5. One executable next hypothesis: “Working Materials”

**Prospective V2 hypothesis:** familiar things remain enjoyable to combine when some outputs are genuinely new materials/forms, and several different finite purposes make those outputs worth learning and reusing. This is not a claim that making the rules harder is better.

Use **the same present/absent fields and actual records** first. Add only a few orthogonal material properties, such as `rigid/flexible`, `transmitting/diffusing/reflecting/opaque`, `porous/watertight`, and `temporary/durable record surface`. Properties belong to the actual relevant surface/part, not to an object-wide union. The goal can require one actual surface to be both supporting and transmitting; a supporting frame elsewhere in an opaque heap must not make the heap a transparent support.

2. **Change a useful thing's role.** An actual soft impression is first used to fit a local opening, then a durable version of that same impressed form must preserve its identity while another actual surface stays porous. A fresh unobserving prefab does not copy the impression; a learned design may still make other blank copies freely.

Run these on the same headless interface and include them in the candidate's complete witness, rather than reporting another two-action slice as a scale result. The smallest **mechanism check** can use these four constructions, but the planned research deliverable below is the complete campaign/collection. If these four already collapse to property-label selection with no valued enactment, reject the transform hypothesis before writing the remaining content; then continue with the competing route, not stop the project.

The scale hypothesis is grounded only weakly: the retained ordinary V1 route supplies 74 interventions; eighteen additional substantive jobs averaging about five to eight contextual interventions, plus zero to twelve actually useful new transformations, would put the collection around **164–230 interventions**. **Do not claim that range from this sentence.** Shared assemblies, combined goal completion and irrelevant branches can shrink it exactly as they did V1. The pre-play deliverable is an executed whole-collection witness ledger, in ordinary, complete and assembly-carryover conditions, replacing every estimate.
